function getBlockRecipeIds(name: string): string[] {
  if (name === "Splintered Oak Planks") {
    return ['splintered_oak_planks'];
  }
  if (name === "Splintered Oak Wood") {
    return ['splintered_oak_wood'];
  }
  if (name === "Nullstone & Cobbled Nullstone") {
    return [
      'nullstone_slab', 'nullstone_stair', 'nullstone_wall',
      'cobbled_nullstone_slab', 'cobbled_nullstone_stair', 'cobbled_nullstone_wall',
      'cracked_nullstone'
    ];
  }
  if (name === "Rotten Oak Wood Family") {
    return [
      'rotten_oak_planks', 'rotten_oak_slab', 'rotten_oak_stair',
      'rotten_oak_fence', 'rotten_oak_gate', 'rotten_oak_trapdoor',
      'rotten_oak_pressure_plate', 'rotten_oak_button', 'rotten_oak_wood'
    ];
  }
  if (name === "Petrified Rotten Oak Wood") {
    return ['petrified_rotten_oak_wood'];
  }
  if (name === "Petrified Rotten Oak Planks, Slab, Stairs & Fence" || name === "Petrified Rotten Oak Family") {
    return [
      'petrified_rotten_oak_planks', 'petrified_rotten_oak_stairs', 'petrified_rotten_oak_slab', 'petrified_rotten_oak_fence', 'petrified_rotten_stick'
    ];
  }
  if (name === "Petrified Oak Planks, Slab, Stairs & Fence Gate" || name === "Petrified Oak Family") {
    return [
      'petrified_oak_stairs', 'petrified_oak_slab', 'petrified_oak_fence', 'petrified_oak_fence_gate'
    ];
  }
  if (name === "Lignum Caro") {
    return ['lignum_caro_trapdoor', 'lignum_caro_sword', 'lignum_caro_ash'];
  }
  if (name === "Lignum Caro Trapdoor") {
    return ['lignum_caro_trapdoor'];
  }
  if (name === "Fractus Core" || name === "Fractus Prime Core") {
    return ['fractus_core_nugget'];
  }
  return [];
}

        "Vanilla Wood Tag Compatibility: Registered under vanilla plank tags, allowing them to craft standard vanilla items like Sticks, Crafting Tables, fences, and tools seamlessly."

  ];

  const filteredBlocks = useMemo(() => {
    return blocks.filter(b => {
      const matchesSearch = b.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) || 
                            b.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
      const matchesDim = selectedDim === 'all' || b.dimension === selectedDim;
      return matchesSearch && matchesDim;
    });
  }, [searchQuery, selectedDim]);

  const toggleMechanics = (name: string) => {
    setExpandedMechanics(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: !prev[name] }));
  };

  const toggleLoot = (name: string) => {
    setExpandedLoot(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: !prev[name] }));
  };

  const areAllExpanded = useMemo(() => {
    if (filteredBlocks.length === 0) return false;
    return filteredBlocks.every(b => {
      const mechOpen = !b.mechanics || b.mechanics.length === 0 || !!expandedMechanics[b.name];
      const lootOpen = !b.lootTable || b.lootTable.length === 0 || !!expandedLoot[b.name];
      return mechOpen && lootOpen;
    });
  }, [filteredBlocks, expandedMechanics, expandedLoot]);

  const toggleExpandAll = () => {
    const nextState = !areAllExpanded;
    const nextMech: Record<string, boolean> = { ...expandedMechanics };
    const nextLoot: Record<string, boolean> = { ...expandedLoot };
    filteredBlocks.forEach(b => {
      if (b.mechanics && b.mechanics.length > 0) nextMech[b.name] = nextState;
      if (b.lootTable && b.lootTable.length > 0) nextLoot[b.name] = nextState;
    });
    setExpandedMechanics(nextMech);
    setExpandedLoot(nextLoot);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 select-text">
      {/* Intro and Search bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 justify-between items-start sm:items-center">
        <p className="text-xs text-[#829285] max-w-xl leading-relaxed">
          Catalog of custom geological, arboreal, and dimensional blocks across Backwoods realms.
        </p>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-60">
            <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#5a6b5e]" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search blocks..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 bg-[#0a0c0a] border border-[#1c241e] rounded-md text-xs text-[#c9d1c9] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#709978] transition-colors placeholder-[#5a6b5e]"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => setCompactMode(prev => !prev)}
            className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono rounded border flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none shrink-0 ${
              compactMode 
                ? 'bg-[#121913] border-[#2c3d2f] text-[#a9d1b0]' 
                : 'bg-[#0a0d0a] border-[#1a231b] text-[#829285] hover:text-[#c9d1c9]'
            }`}
            title={compactMode ? "Switch to Expanded View" : "Switch to Compact View"}
          >
            <LayoutGrid className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">{compactMode ? 'Compact' : 'Expanded'}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={toggleExpandAll}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono rounded border bg-[#0a0d0a] border-[#1a231b] text-[#829285] hover:text-[#c9d1c9] flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none shrink-0"
            title={areAllExpanded ? "Collapse All Details" : "Expand All Details"}
          >
            {areAllExpanded ? <Minimize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">{areAllExpanded ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 border-b border-[#1a221c] pb-2.5">
        {[
          { id: 'all', label: 'All', count: blocks.length },
          { id: 'overworld', label: 'Overworld', count: blocks.filter(b => b.dimension === 'overworld').length },
          { id: 'backwoods_rotting', label: 'Backwoods & Rotting', count: blocks.filter(b => b.dimension === 'backwoods_rotting').length },
          { id: 'loss', label: 'The Loss', count: blocks.filter(b => b.dimension === 'loss').length },
          { id: 'petrified_weald', label: 'Petrified Weald', count: blocks.filter(b => b.dimension === 'petrified_weald').length }
        ].map(tab => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            onClick={() => setSelectedDim(tab.id)}
            className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono rounded transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              selectedDim === tab.id
                ? 'bg-[#1a241d] text-[#a9d1b0] border border-[#2e3e31]'
                : 'bg-transparent text-[#829285] hover:text-[#e0e7e0] border border-transparent'
            }`}
          >
            <span>{tab.label}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] opacity-60">({tab.count})</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Grid List */}
      <div className={`grid gap-3.5 ${
        compactMode 
          ? 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3' 
          : 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2'
      }`}>
        {filteredBlocks.map((block) => {
          const isMechOpen = !compactMode || !!expandedMechanics[block.name];
          const isLootOpen = !compactMode || !!expandedLoot[block.name];
          const recipeIds = getBlockRecipeIds(block.name);
          const isRecipeOpen = !!expandedRecipes[block.name];

          const cardContent = (
            <div 
              key={block.name}
              data-telemetry-item={block.name}
              className="p-3.5 sm:p-4 bg-[#0a0d0a] border border-[#172018] rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-[#2a382d] transition-all duration-200 h-full space-y-3"
            >
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {/* Card Header */}
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <h3 className="font-serif text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-[#e0e7e0] leading-snug break-words" title={block.name}>
                      {block.name}
                    </h3>
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-mono uppercase text-[#709978] bg-[#111712] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-[#1b251c] mt-1 inline-block">
                      {block.dimension.replace('_', ' & ')}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  
                  {/* Latin title translation if exists */}
                  {block.latin && (
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-right text-[#5a6b5e] shrink-0">
                      {block.latin.map((l, idx) => (
                        <div key={idx}>
                          <span className="text-rose-400 font-semibold">"{l.term}"</span>: {l.translation}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Stats badges */}
                {(block.hardness || block.blastRes || block.burnTime || block.tool) && (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 py-1 border-y border-[#161f18]/60 text-[10px] font-mono">
                    {block.hardness && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#101411] border border-[#18221a] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[#829285]">
                        <Hammer className="w-3 h-3 text-[#5a6b5e]" />
                        <span>Hardness:</span>
                        <strong className="text-[#a9d1b0]">{block.hardness}</strong>
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {block.blastRes && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#101411] border border-[#18221a] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[#829285]">
                        <Shield className="w-3 h-3 text-[#5a6b5e]" />
                        <span>Blast:</span>
                        <strong className="text-[#a9d1b0]">{block.blastRes}</strong>
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {block.burnTime && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#101411] border border-[#18221a] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[#829285]">
                        <Flame className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-500/80" />
                        <span>Burn:</span>
                        <strong className="text-amber-400">{block.burnTime}</strong>
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {block.tool && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#101411] border border-[#18221a] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[#829285]">
                        <Hammer className="w-3 h-3 text-[#709978]" />
                        <span>Tool:</span>
                        <strong className="text-[#a9d1b0]">{block.tool}</strong>
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Description */}
                <p className="text-xs text-[#829285] leading-relaxed">
                  {block.description}
                </p>

                {/* Warnings and Hazards */}
                {block.isWarning && (
                  <div className="p-2 bg-[#191010] border-l-2 border-rose-500 rounded text-[10px] text-rose-300 leading-snug flex items-start gap-1.5 select-none">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span>{block.warningText}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Material safety */}
                {block.isSpecial && (
                  <div className="p-2 bg-[#101511] border-l-2 border-emerald-500 rounded text-[10px] text-emerald-300 leading-snug flex items-start gap-1.5 select-none">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span>{block.specialText}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Behavioral Mechanics collapsible */}
                {block.mechanics && block.mechanics.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => toggleMechanics(block.name)}
                      className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-[#070907] hover:bg-[#0f140f] border border-[#162018] hover:border-[#243326] rounded text-[10px] font-mono text-[#709978] hover:text-[#a9d1b0] transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none"
                    >
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#709978]/60" />
                        <span>Behavioral Mechanics ({block.mechanics.length})</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-[#5a6b5e] flex items-center gap-0.5">
                        {isMechOpen ? <><ChevronUp className="w-3 h-3" /> Hide</> : <><ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3" /> View</>}
                      </span>
                    </button>

                    {isMechOpen && (
                      <div className="space-y-1.5 text-[11px] text-[#829285] leading-relaxed bg-[#060806] p-2.5 rounded border border-[#141c15]">
                        {block.mechanics.map((mech, mIdx) => (
                          <div key={mIdx} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#527058] shrink-0 mt-1.5" />
                            <div className="flex-1">
                              {mech.includes(':') ? (
                                <>
                                  <strong className="text-[#c9d1c9] font-semibold">{mech.split(':')[0]}:</strong>
                                  <span>{mech.split(':')[1]}</span>
                                </>
                              ) : (
                                <span>{mech}</span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Loot Table collapsible */}
                {block.lootTable && (
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-0.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => toggleLoot(block.name)}
                      className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-[#070907] hover:bg-[#0f140f] border border-[#162018] hover:border-[#243326] rounded text-[10px] font-mono text-[#709978] hover:text-[#a9d1b0] transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none"
                    >
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Coins className="w-3 h-3 text-[#5a6b5e]" />
                        <span>Loot Drops ({block.lootTable.length})</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-[#5a6b5e] flex items-center gap-0.5">
                        {isLootOpen ? <><ChevronUp className="w-3 h-3" /> Hide</> : <><ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3" /> View</>}
                      </span>
                    </button>

                    {isLootOpen && (
                      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded border border-[#162018] text-[9px] font-mono">
                        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                          <thead>
                            <tr className="bg-[#0e120f] text-[#5a6b5e] border-b border-[#162018]">
                              <th className="p-1.5">Drop</th>
                              <th className="p-1.5 text-center">Weight</th>
                              <th className="p-1.5 text-right">Condition</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#141b15]">
                            {block.lootTable.map((loot, lIdx) => (
                              <tr key={lIdx}>
                                <td className="p-1.5 font-medium text-[#c9d1c9]">{loot.item}</td>
                                <td className="p-1.5 text-center text-[#829285]">{loot.weight}</td>
                                <td className="p-1.5 text-right text-[#5a6b5e] font-sans italic">{loot.condition}</td>
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Collapsible Crafting Recipes */}
                {recipeIds.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="pt-0.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setExpandedRecipes(prev => ({ ...prev, [block.name]: !isRecipeOpen }))}
                      className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-[#070907] hover:bg-[#0f140f] border border-[#162018] hover:border-[#243326] rounded text-[10px] font-mono text-[#709978] hover:text-[#a9d1b0] transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none"
                    >
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Hammer className="w-3 h-3 text-[#5a6b5e]" />
                        <span>Crafting Recipes ({recipeIds.length})</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-[#5a6b5e] flex items-center gap-0.5">
                        {isRecipeOpen ? <><ChevronUp className="w-3 h-3" /> Hide</> : <><ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3" /> View</>}
                      </span>
                    </button>

                    {isRecipeOpen && (
                      <div className="mt-2.5">
                        <FancyRecipeView itemIds={recipeIds} />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );

          if (block.isUpdated) {
            return (
              <UpdatedFrame key={block.name} id={`block_${block.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_')}`} isUpdated={true}>
                {cardContent}
              </UpdatedFrame>
            );
          }

          return cardContent;
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopy(`/combatkit ${kit.name}`)}
                      className="mt-4 w-full text-center py-1.5 bg-[#101411] hover:bg-[#18201a] border border-[#202c22] rounded text-[10px] font-mono text-[#a9d1b0] transition-all cursor-pointer select-none"
                    >
                      Copy Kit Trigger
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </UpdatedFrame>
      </div>
    ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Compass, ShieldAlert, Flame, Eye, Image as ImageIcon, Search, X, Maximize2, ChevronDown, Check, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';

function getAbsoluteAssetUrl(url: string) {
  if (!url) return '';
  if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://')) {
    return url;
  }
  
  const cleanUrl = url.startsWith('/') ? url.slice(1) : url;
  const pathname = window.location.pathname;
  const segments = pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  const isGitHubPages = window.location.hostname.endsWith('github.io');
  
  let base = '';
  if (isGitHubPages && segments.length > 0) {
    base = `/${segments[0]}/`;
  } else {
    const viteBase = import.meta.env.BASE_URL || '/';
    if (viteBase === './' || viteBase === '.') {
      base = '/';
    } else {
      base = viteBase.endsWith('/') ? viteBase : `${viteBase}/`;
    }
  }
  
  return `${base}${cleanUrl}`;
}

const getThreatBadgeStyle = (threatLevel: string) => {
  switch (threatLevel) {
    case 'Extermination Class':
      return 'threat-badge threat-badge-extermination bg-[#251012] border border-red-500/70 text-red-400 font-bold animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(239,68,68,0.75)]';
    case 'Extreme':
      return 'threat-badge threat-badge-extreme bg-[#221315] border border-red-900/50 text-[#cf8f92] font-semibold shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(239,68,68,0.45)]';
    case 'High':
      return 'threat-badge threat-badge-high bg-[#1a1318] border border-[#3f2123]/40 text-[#b5a3bd] shadow-[0_0_4px_rgba(239,68,68,0.25)]';
    case 'Medium':
      return 'threat-badge threat-badge-medium bg-[#1a1715] border border-[#2f2824]/40 text-[#c2b09f]';
    case 'Low':
      return 'threat-badge threat-badge-low bg-[#141715] border border-[#222924]/40 text-[#9bb0a0]';
    case 'Passive':
    default:
      return 'threat-badge threat-badge-passive bg-[#111412] border border-[#1b221d]/40 text-[#829285]';
  }
};

  const handleEntitySelect = (entityId: string) => {
    setSelectedEntity(entityId);
    setOpenAbilityIndex(0);
    const matchedEntity = entities.find(e => e.id === entityId);
    trackTelemetryClick({
      page: 'entities',
      target: matchedEntity ? matchedEntity.name : entityId,
      category: matchedEntity ? matchedEntity.threatLevel : 'entity'
    });
    if (entityId === 'rot') {
      const now = Date.now();
      const recent = [...rotClickTimesRef.current, now].filter(t => now - t <= 2000);
      rotClickTimesRef.current = recent;
      if (recent.length >= 5) {
        rotClickTimesRef.current = [];
        window.location.hash = '#/wiki/rot-lab';
      }
    } else {
      rotClickTimesRef.current = [];
    }
  };

  const toggleAbility = (idx: number) => {
    setOpenAbilityIndex(openAbilityIndex === idx ? null : idx);
  };

  // Sync with Table of Contents clicks
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleHeadingClick = (e: Event) => {
      const customEvent = e as CustomEvent<{ id: string }>;
      const targetId = customEvent.detail.id;
      
      const matched = entities.find(entity => {
        const normalizedTarget = targetId.toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, '_');
        const normalizedId = entity.id.toLowerCase();
        
        if (normalizedTarget === normalizedId) return true;
        if (normalizedTarget.includes(normalizedId)) return true;
        if (normalizedId === 'splinter' && normalizedTarget === 'the_splinter') return true;
        if (normalizedId === 'rot' && normalizedTarget === 'the_rot') return true;
        if (normalizedId === 'hollow' && normalizedTarget === 'the_hollow') return true;
        if (normalizedId === 'ash_weaver' && normalizedTarget === 'the_ash_weaver') return true;
        if (normalizedId === 'petrified_splinter' && normalizedTarget === 'petrified_log_splinter') return true;
        return false;
      });

      if (matched) {
        setSelectedEntity(matched.id);
        setSearchQuery('');
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('wiki-scroll-to-heading', handleHeadingClick);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('wiki-scroll-to-heading', handleHeadingClick);
  }, [entities]);

  const getAbilitiesForEntity = (entityId: string): Ability[] => {
    switch (entityId) {
      case 'rot': return rotAbilities;
      case 'woodweaver': return woodweaverAbilities;
      case 'splinter': return splinterAbilities;
      case 'log_splinter': return splinterAbilities;
      case 'petrified_splinter': return petrifiedSplinterAbilities;
      case 'blindspot_splinter': return blindspotAbilities;
      case 'ash_weaver': return ashWeaverAbilities;
      case 'lignum_gigas': return lignumGigasAbilities;
      case 'verdant_engine': return verdantEngineAbilities;
      case 'hollow': return hollowAbilities;
      case 'fractus_prime': return fractusPrimeAbilities;
      case 'fractus': return fractusAbilities;
      case 'stilt_walker': return stiltWalkerAbilities;
      case 'lignum_palus': return lignumPalusAbilities;
      case 'dorceless_splinter': return dorcelessSplinterAbilities;
      case 'kyne_splinter': return kyneSplinterAbilities;
      case 'lignum_spina': return lignumSpinaAbilities;
      case 'petrified_lignum_spina': return petrifiedLignumSpinaAbilities;
      case 'lignum_echinus': return lignumEchinusAbilities;
      case 'petrified_lignum_echinus': return petrifiedLignumEchinusAbilities;
      case 'lignum_trilobita': return lignumTrilobitaAbilities;
      case 'petrified_lignum_trilobita': return petrifiedLignumTrilobitaAbilities;
      case 'hewn_splinter': return hewnSplinterAbilities;
      default: return [];
    }
  };

  const getEntityExtraKeywords = (entityId: string): string => {
    switch (entityId) {
      case 'stilt_walker':
        return 'Spawn Grace Protection System 20 ticks 1s 60 ticks 3s stalk cycle predictive dodging immune damage';
      case 'ash_weaver':
        return 'Botanical Symbiote The Thicket companion trust familiarity fear hiding peeking roses warnings portal travel home cave campsite watchtower doors chat commands FSM finite state machine BFS topological survey centroid trauma buffer quota budget conical sweep edge brake lateral dodge kinematics';

      case 'fractus_prime':
        return 'Tractor beam grip escape energy sphere burst echolocation network sub-terranean fortification sonar acoustic radar concussive shockwave';

      case 'blindspot_splinter':
      case 'petrified_splinter':
        return 'Decay shared hivemind learning cover projectile immunity afterimages invisible flank surround coalescence sticks planks logs flower pot';
      case 'lignum_palus':
        return 'Architectural mimicry gaze hypnosis flashing particle aura grid-aligned teleportation Y=20 Y=46 subterranean';

        return 'Tunneling subterranean burrowing earth tremor ambush';
      case 'hewn_splinter':
        return 'Static wooden effigy projectile arrow immunity fluid pushes falling anvils invulnerability';
      case 'woodweaver':
        return 'The Grain dormant stalker emergency smoke screen gaze evasion dread accumulation cellular collapse vaporize beam core exhaustion ramming dash combustion wave';
      case 'rot':
        return 'Alpha Threat Sentinel 96-node synthetic neural array superheater armor choke sonic boom acoustic shockwave rider kick aerial martial strikes mace dive cellular surge multi-agent swarm boss immunity override';
      case 'verdant_engine':
        return 'Spacetime anomaly 2500 HP reality anchoring gravitational collapse singularity pulses';
      case 'lignum_gigas':
        return 'Colossal kinetic stomp ancient bark armor ground pound shockwave forest resonance anchored';
      case 'kyne_splinter':
        return 'Erratic movement high agility';
      case 'dorceless_splinter':
        return 'Heavy armored plating plodding gait';
      case 'hollow':
        return 'Phase-shifting spruce biped explosions drowning';
      case 'lignum_spina':
      case 'petrified_lignum_spina':
        return 'Thorns reflection sweet berry thorns damage Y=50 upper forest';
      case 'lignum_echinus':
      case 'petrified_lignum_echinus':
        return 'Spikes sweet berry thorns damage';
      case 'lignum_trilobita':
      case 'petrified_lignum_trilobita':
        return 'Suffocation resistance falling anvils';
      default:
        return '';
    }
  };

  const sortedEntities = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (sortBy === 'default') return entities;
    return [...entities].sort((a, b) => {
      const valA = THREAT_VALUES[a.threatLevel] || 0;
      const valB = THREAT_VALUES[b.threatLevel] || 0;
      return sortBy === 'threat-asc' ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
    });
  }, [sortBy, entities]);

  const filteredEntities = React.useMemo(() => {
    const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return sortedEntities;

    const queryWords = query.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);

    const matches: { entity: EntityProfile; score: number; matchReason: string }[] = [];

    for (const entity of sortedEntities) {
      const abilities = getAbilitiesForEntity(entity.id);
      const immunities = ENTITY_IMMUNITIES[entity.id] || [];
      const extraKeywords = getEntityExtraKeywords(entity.id);
      const abilityString = abilities.map(a => `${a.title} ${a.trigger} ${a.description} ${a.category}`).join(' ');
      const immunityString = immunities.join(' ');

      const combinedText = [
        entity.id,
        entity.name,
        entity.title,
        entity.aka || '',
        entity.threatLevel,
        entity.hp,
        entity.damage,
        entity.armor,
        entity.speed,
        entity.dim,
        entity.desc,
        immunityString,
        abilityString,
        extraKeywords
      ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

      const allWordsMatch = queryWords.every(w => combinedText.includes(w));
      if (!allWordsMatch) continue;

      let score = 0;
      let matchReason = '';

      const nameLower = entity.name.toLowerCase();
      const idLower = entity.id.toLowerCase();
      const titleLower = entity.title.toLowerCase();
      const akaLower = (entity.aka || '').toLowerCase();

      if (idLower === query) {
        score += 1000;
        matchReason = 'Exact ID';
      } else if (nameLower === query) {
        score += 800;
        matchReason = 'Exact Name';
      } else if (nameLower.startsWith(query)) {
        score += 500;
        matchReason = 'Name Match';
      } else if (nameLower.includes(query)) {
        score += 300;
        matchReason = 'Name Match';
      } else if (akaLower.includes(query)) {
        score += 250;
        matchReason = `AKA: ${entity.aka}`;
      } else if (titleLower.includes(query)) {
        score += 200;
        matchReason = entity.title;
      } else {
        const foundAbility = abilities.find(a => 
          a.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
          a.category.toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
          a.description.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
          a.trigger.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );
        if (foundAbility) {
          score += 150;
          matchReason = `Ability: ${foundAbility.title}`;
        } else {
          const foundImmunity = immunities.find(imm => imm.toLowerCase().includes(query));
          if (foundImmunity) {
            score += 130;
            matchReason = `Immunity: ${foundImmunity}`;
          } else if (entity.threatLevel.toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
            score += 110;
            matchReason = `Threat: ${entity.threatLevel}`;
          } else if (entity.dim.toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
            score += 90;
            matchReason = `Habitat / Dim`;
          } else if (entity.hp.toLowerCase().includes(query) || entity.damage.toLowerCase().includes(query)) {
            score += 80;
            matchReason = `Combat Stat`;
          } else {
            score += 40;
            matchReason = `Dossier Content`;
          }
        }
      }

      matches.push({ entity, score, matchReason });
    }

    matches.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    return matches.map(m => ({ ...m.entity, _matchReason: m.matchReason }));
  }, [searchQuery, sortedEntities]);

  // Auto-select the top matching entity when search query changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
    if (filteredEntities.length > 0) {
      const topEntity = filteredEntities[0];
      setSelectedEntity(topEntity.id);

      const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
      const abilities = getAbilitiesForEntity(topEntity.id);
      const matchedAbilityIdx = abilities.findIndex(a => 
        a.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
        a.description.toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
        a.category.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        a.trigger.toLowerCase().includes(query)
      );

      if (matchedAbilityIdx !== -1) {
        setOpenAbilityIndex(matchedAbilityIdx);
      } else {
        setOpenAbilityIndex(0);
      }
    }
  }, [searchQuery]);

  const currentEntity = entities.find(e => e.id === selectedEntity) || entities[0];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 select-text">
      
      {/* Intro section */}
      <div className="p-5 bg-[#0f1210] border border-[#1c241e] rounded-lg">
        <p className="text-sm text-[#c9d1c9] leading-relaxed">
          The Backwoods environment is populated by highly aggressive, adaptive organisms. This dossier provides classified intelligence, operational mechanics, and behavioral logic for all documented entities.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* SENSOR INTERFERENCE & F3 COORDINATE OBFUSCATION */}
      <UpdatedFrame id="entity_sensor_interference" isUpdated={true}>
        <div className="p-5 bg-[#0e120f] border border-[#223326] rounded-xl space-y-3 shadow-md">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-[#1c291f] pb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#709978] font-mono text-xs uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">
              <Compass className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Sensory Distortion: Proximity Interference & F3 Obfuscation</span>
            </div>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#142018] border border-[#284030] text-emerald-300 self-start sm:self-auto">
              24-BLOCK PROXIMITY FIELD
            </span>
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#c9d1c9] leading-relaxed">
            Approaching within <strong className="text-white">24 blocks</strong> of anomalous Backwoods organisms actively jams navigational tools and telemetry overlays to prevent coordinate evading:
          </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-1">
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-[#0a0d0b] border border-[#1a251c] rounded-lg space-y-1.5">
              <div className="font-serif text-xs font-bold text-[#e0e7e0] flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
                <span>Compass Needle Instability</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#829285] leading-relaxed pl-3.5">
                The compass needle oscillates and twitches violently away from world spawn, spinning with velocity proportional to creature distance. Apex organisms (The Rot, Lignum Gigas, and Fractus Prime) amplify this distortion up to 1.8x.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 bg-[#0a0d0b] border border-[#1a251c] rounded-lg space-y-1.5">
              <div className="font-serif text-xs font-bold text-[#e0e7e0] flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
                <span>F3 Debug Screen Scrambling</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#829285] leading-relaxed pl-3.5">
                Coordinates and situational data in the F3 debug screen are dynamically scrambled into shifting gibberish. At moderate proximity, XYZ coordinates, Block, Chunk, Facing direction, Biome, and entity count are scrambled; at close contact, the entire overlay is obscured.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </UpdatedFrame>

      {/* Main Grid: Sidebar + Profile Details */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
        
        {/* Sidebar Selector */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-3">
          {/* Entity Search Bar */}
          <UpdatedFrame id="entity_search_module" isUpdated={true}>
            <div className="p-3 bg-[#0a0d0b] border border-[#1b251d] rounded-lg space-y-2 shadow-sm">
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#5a6b5e]" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search entities, abilities, stats..."
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-7 py-1.5 text-xs bg-[#050705] border border-[#172019] text-[#c9d1c9] rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:border-[#709978] placeholder-[#445247] transition-all font-mono"
                />
                {searchQuery && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                    className="absolute right-2 top-2 text-[#5a6b5e] hover:text-[#e0e7e0] p-0.5 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    title="Clear search"
                  >
                    <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-[#5a6b5e]">
                <span>
                  {searchQuery.trim() ? (
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                      {filteredEntities.length} matching {filteredEntities.length === 1 ? 'entity' : 'entities'}
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span>{entities.length} documented organisms</span>
                  )}
                </span>
                {searchQuery.trim() && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                    className="text-[#709978] hover:text-[#a9d1b0] underline cursor-pointer text-[9px]"
                  >
                    Clear Filter
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </UpdatedFrame>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
            <h4 className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[#5a6b5e]">Threat Database Index</h4>
            <button 
              onClick={() => {
                setSortBy(prev => prev === 'default' ? 'threat-asc' : prev === 'threat-asc' ? 'threat-desc' : 'default');
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] font-mono px-2 py-1 bg-[#0a0c0a] hover:bg-[#121612] text-[#829285] hover:text-[#e0e7e0] border border-[#161c17] rounded transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-[#709978]" />

              </span>
            </button>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-1 gap-1.5 max-h-[420px] lg:max-h-none overflow-y-auto pr-1 scrollbar-thin">
            {filteredEntities.length === 0 ? (

                          {e.name}

                        <span className={`text-[7px] font-mono uppercase px-1 py-0.5 rounded ${getThreatBadgeStyle(e.threatLevel)}`}>
                          {e.threatLevel}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[9px] text-[#5a6b5e] font-mono mt-0.5 italic leading-tight flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                        <span className="truncate">{e.title}</span>
                        {searchQuery.trim() && e._matchReason && (

        <div className="lg:col-span-8 p-6 bg-[#0c0e0c] border border-[#1d251e] rounded-xl relative overflow-hidden space-y-6">
          
          {/* Accent glow */}
          <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 w-36 h-36 bg-red-950/10 blur-3xl rounded-full pointer-events-none" />

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-[#1a221c]">

                              <div className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono ${accordionStyles.triggerText}`}>

          {/* THE ROT: Custom mechanics */}

Effectively a permanent, uncappable version of the empowered state.

It shredded through my obsidian walls like paper. Then, it grabbed the Totem of Undying directly out of my hand, crushed it, and absorbed the particles to empower itself. I survived only by crawling into a rock fissure..."`,
                      `"Do not trust your armor. It doesn't just hit you—it strips away your safety. I was backed into a ravine wall, completely immobilized by a sudden, heavy pressure in the air that made it feel like gravity had tripled. It reached out, and with a horrifying, metallic screech, it tore my iron chestplate clean off my body like it was wet paper. I didn't even feel a blade; it just dismantled my protection in a second. I had to ditch the rest of my gear and squeeze into a one-block crawlspace just to escape."`,
                      `"My skin is still blistering. It manipulates the air around you to torture your senses. First, a wave of absolute, biting frost hit me, freezing the breath in my throat and locking up my joints so I couldn't run. The moment the ice took hold, the atmosphere instantly flipped to a blinding, searing heat. The sudden shock of going from sub-zero to boiling cracked my shield right down the middle. If I hadn't dug frantically into the dirt to bury myself, I would have been ash."`,
                      `"I tried to play dirty. I brought three Wither skulls down into the thick of the trees, thinking I could let two monsters destroy each other. It was an insult to the thing. It didn't even flinch at the decay. It met the beast head-on, shattering its skulls with consecutive, deafening strikes that sounded like thunderclaps. Then, it let out a localized scream so violent it shook the valley and blew out my eardrums—a terrifying echo of the deep dark, weaponized in the open air. The woods don't belong to the old legends anymore."`

  if (mapping[cleanId]) {
    return {
      short: mapping[cleanId].short,
      name: displayName,
      bgClass: mapping[cleanId].bg,
      textClass: mapping[cleanId].text,
      borderClass: mapping[cleanId].border,
      glowClass: mapping[cleanId].glow
    };
  }

  // Automatic abbreviation rules
  const words = cleanId.split('_');
  let abbrev = '';
  if (words.length >= 3) {
    abbrev = (words[0][0] + words[1][0] + words[2][0]).toUpperCase();
  } else if (words.length === 2) {
    abbrev = (words[0][0] + words[1][0]).toUpperCase();
  } else if (cleanId.length > 0) {
    abbrev = cleanId[0].toUpperCase() + (cleanId[1] || '').toLowerCase();
  } else {
    abbrev = '?';
  }

  // Fallback styling: neutral high-quality dark-greenish gray
  return {
    short: abbrev,
    name: displayName,
    bgClass: 'bg-[#0d100d]',
    textClass: 'text-[#a9d1b0]',
    borderClass: 'border-[#223024]',
    glowClass: 'group-hover:shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(169,209,176,0.1)]'
  };
}

// Helper to sanitize internal names for display
function getCleanName(rawId: string): string {
  if (!rawId) return '';
  let name = rawId.replace('the_backwoods:', '').replace('minecraft:', '');
  return name
    .split('_')
    .map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
    .join(' ');
}

// Map the display item IDs from ItemsView.tsx to their real Minecraft registry names
const itemIdMapping: Record<string, string> = {
  'steel_charcoal': 'the_backwoods:backwoods',
  'steel_shard': 'the_backwoods:the_petrified_weald',
  'effigy': 'the_backwoods:rot_effigy',
  'pale_draught': 'the_backwoods:pale_draught_bottle',
};

export default function FancyRecipeView({ itemIds, title }: FancyRecipeViewProps) {
  const [activeRecipeIndex, setActiveRecipeIndex] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});

  // Gather all recipes for the given item IDs
  const itemsWithRecipes = itemIds
    .map(id => {
      const cleanId = id.startsWith('the_backwoods:') ? id.replace('the_backwoods:', '') : id;
      const mappedId = itemIdMapping[cleanId] || id;
      const normalizedId = mappedId.startsWith('the_backwoods:') ? mappedId : `the_backwoods:${mappedId}`;
      const recipes = recipeDetails[normalizedId] || [];
      return { id: normalizedId, name: getCleanName(normalizedId), recipes };
    })
    .filter(item => item.recipes.length > 0);

  if (itemsWithRecipes.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 mt-4 select-text">
      {title && (
        <h4 className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[#709978] mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
          <Hammer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          {title}
        </h4>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-4">
        {itemsWithRecipes.map(item => {
          const recipes = item.recipes;
          const currentIndex = activeRecipeIndex[item.id] || 0;
          const recipe = recipes[currentIndex];
          if (!recipe) return null;

          const isMultiRecipe = recipes.length > 1;

          // Render appropriate layout based on recipe type
          const isSmelting = recipe.type.includes('smelting') || recipe.type.includes('blasting');
          const isStonecutting = recipe.type.includes('stonecutting');
          const isSmithing = recipe.type.includes('smithing') || (recipe.ingredients.length === 2 && recipe.ingredients.some(i => i.includes('sword') || i.includes('tool')) && recipe.ingredients.some(i => i.includes('shard')));
          const isBrewing = recipe.type.includes('brewing') || recipe.type.includes('brew');

          const outputSpec = getItemVisualSpec(item.id);

          return (
            <div 
              key={item.id} 
              className="bg-[#050605] border border-[#141b15] rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 relative transition-all hover:border-[#1e2a1f]"
            >
              {/* Subtle background glow wrapper to contain blur without clipping card tooltips */}
              <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-xl overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
                <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-24 h-24 bg-emerald-950/10 blur-2xl rounded-full" />
              </div>

              {/* Recipe Header */}
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 pb-2 border-b border-[#121813]/60">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#5a6b5e] uppercase tracking-wider">

                  </span>
                  <h5 className="font-serif text-sm font-bold text-[#e0e7e0] mt-0.5">
                    {item.name} <span className="text-xs text-[#829285] font-normal font-sans">(Yield: x{recipe.outputCount})</span>
                  </h5>
                </div>

                {isMultiRecipe && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      const nextIdx = (currentIndex + 1) % recipes.length;
                      setActiveRecipeIndex(prev => ({ ...prev, [item.id]: nextIdx }));
                    }}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-mono bg-[#111612] border border-[#1e2820] text-[#709978] rounded hover:text-[#a9d1b0] hover:border-[#2e3e31] transition-all cursor-pointer select-none"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin-hover" />

                )}
              </div>

              {/* Responsive Visual-First Stacked Layout */}

                    {isSmelting ? (

                      {/* Furnace Input Slot */}

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 bg-[#090b09] p-2 rounded-xl border border-[#1b251d] shadow-[inset_0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)] shrink-0">
                        {(() => {
                          const pattern = recipe.pattern || ["abc", "def", "ghi"];
                          const isShapeless = recipe.type === 'minecraft:crafting_shapeless';

                          if (isShapeless) {
                            // Shapeless ingredients mapped in sequence
                            for (let idx = 0; idx < 9; idx++) {
                                const ingredient = recipe.ingredients[idx];
                                if (ingredient) {
                                  const spec = getItemVisualSpec(ingredient);
                                  cells.push(
                                    <div key={idx} className="relative group shrink-0 hover:z-30">
                                      <div className={`w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 md:w-10 md:h-10 border rounded-lg flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-0.5 shadow-inner transition-all duration-200 cursor-help ${spec.bgClass} ${spec.borderClass} ${spec.textClass} ${spec.glowClass} hover:border-[#709978] shrink-0`}>
                                        <span className="text-[8px] sm:text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono font-bold">{spec.short}</span>
                                      </div>
                                      {/* Tooltip */}
                                      <div className="opacity-0 pointer-events-none group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-200 absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 bg-[#080a08] border border-[#223024] text-xs font-mono p-2 rounded shadow-2xl z-30 flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 min-w-[125px]">
                                        <span className="text-[#a9d1b0] font-bold font-serif text-center whitespace-nowrap">{spec.name}</span>
                                        <span className="text-[9px] text-[#5a6b5e] uppercase tracking-wider">{ingredient.replace('the_backwoods:', '').replace('minecraft:', '')}</span>
                                        <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border-4 border-transparent border-t-[#223024]" />
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  );
                                } else {
                                  cells.push(
                                    <div key={idx} className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 md:w-10 md:h-10 bg-[#040504] border border-[#121612] rounded-lg shadow-[inset_0_1.5px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] opacity-25 shrink-0" />
                                  );
                                }
                            }
                          } else {
                            // Shaped pattern mapping
                            for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
                              const row = pattern[r] || '   ';
                              for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                                const char = row[c] || ' ';
                                if (char !== ' ') {
                                  const keyVal = recipe.keyMap?.[char];
                                  const fullItemName = keyVal?.item ? keyVal.item : (keyVal?.tag ? `#${keyVal.tag}` : char);
                                  const spec = getItemVisualSpec(fullItemName);
                                  cells.push(
                                    <div key={`${r}-${c}`} className="relative group shrink-0 hover:z-30">
                                      <div className={`w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 md:w-10 md:h-10 border rounded-lg flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-0.5 shadow-inner transition-all duration-200 cursor-help ${spec.bgClass} ${spec.borderClass} ${spec.textClass} ${spec.glowClass} hover:border-[#709978] shrink-0`}>
                                        <span className="text-[8px] sm:text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono font-bold">{spec.short}</span>
                                      </div>
                                      {/* Tooltip */}
                                      <div className="opacity-0 pointer-events-none group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-200 absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 bg-[#080a08] border border-[#223024] text-xs font-mono p-2 rounded shadow-2xl z-30 flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 min-w-[125px]">
                                        <span className="text-[#a9d1b0] font-bold font-serif text-center whitespace-nowrap">{spec.name}</span>
                                        <span className="text-[9px] text-[#5a6b5e] uppercase tracking-wider">{fullItemName.replace('the_backwoods:', '').replace('minecraft:', '')}</span>
                                        <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border-4 border-transparent border-t-[#223024]" />
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  );
                                } else {
                                  cells.push(
                                    <div key={`${r}-${c}`} className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 md:w-10 md:h-10 bg-[#040504] border border-[#121612] rounded-lg shadow-[inset_0_1.5px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] opacity-25 shrink-0" />
                                  );
                                }
                              }
                            }
                          }

                          return cells;
                        })()}
                      </div>

                      {/* Arrow */}
                      <div className="text-[#3a4f3e] font-bold text-base sm:text-lg select-none animate-pulse shrink-0">→</div>

                      {/* Large Output Slot */}
                      <div className="relative group shrink-0 hover:z-30">
                        <div className={`w-12 h-12 sm:w-13 sm:h-13 md:w-14 md:h-14 border-2 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1 shadow-inner transition-all duration-300 ${outputSpec.bgClass} ${outputSpec.borderClass} ${outputSpec.textClass} ${outputSpec.glowClass} shrink-0`}>
                          <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono font-bold tracking-tight">{outputSpec.short}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span className="absolute bottom-0.5 right-0.5 bg-[#121613] border border-[#303d33] px-1 py-0.5 text-[8px] sm:text-[9px] font-mono text-[#a9d1b0] font-bold rounded shadow-md z-10 select-none">
                          x{recipe.outputCount}
                        </span>
                        {/* Tooltip */}
                        <div className="opacity-0 pointer-events-none group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-200 absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 bg-[#080a08] border border-[#223024] text-xs font-mono p-2 rounded shadow-2xl z-20 flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 min-w-[120px]">
                          <span className="text-[#a9d1b0] font-bold font-serif text-center whitespace-nowrap">{outputSpec.name}</span>
                          <span className="text-[9px] text-[#5a6b5e] uppercase tracking-wider">{item.id}</span>
                          <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 border-4 border-transparent border-t-[#223024]" />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 2. Textual Specifications (Split cleanly on wider screens, stacked on small mobile) */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-3 border-t border-[#121813]/60">
                  {/* Ingredients */}
                  <div>
                    <h6 className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#5a6b5e] mb-1.5 font-bold">Ingredients Inventory</h6>
                    <ul className="text-xs text-[#829285] space-y-1 font-mono list-disc pl-4">
                      {recipe.ingredients.map((ing, idx) => {
                        let cleanText = ing;
                        if (ing.includes(' = ')) {
                          const parts = ing.split(' = ');
                          cleanText = `${parts[0].toUpperCase()}: ${getCleanName(parts[1])}`;
                        } else if (ing.startsWith('Input: ')) {
                          cleanText = `INPUT: ${getCleanName(ing.replace('Input: ', ''))}`;
                        } else {
                          cleanText = getCleanName(ing);
                        }

                        return (
                          <li key={idx} className="leading-relaxed">
                            <span className="text-[#c9d1c9]">{cleanText}</span>
                          </li>
                        );
                      })}
                    </ul>
                  </div>

                  {/* Metadata & File Info */}
                  <div className="flex flex-col justify-between text-[9px] font-mono text-[#5a6b5e] space-y-2">
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <div className="leading-normal">
                        Recipe source file:<br />
                        <span className="text-[#405244] break-all select-all hover:text-[#709978] transition-colors">{recipe.file}</span>
                      </div>
                      
                      {recipe.type === 'minecraft:crafting_shapeless' && (
                        <div className="inline-block bg-[#1b1c1b] border border-[#262c26] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] text-[#829285] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase">
                          Shapeless Crafting
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * ========================================================================================
 * AI ASSISTANT MAINTENANCE NOTICE & CONTROL PROTOCOL:
 * ========================================================================================
 * REMINDER FOR AI ASSISTANTS:
 * The Telemetry system (StatsModal & LiveRadiansTab) is the secret control panel of the wiki.
 * It provides live multi-client synchronization, celestial rotation telemetry, real-time audit
 * log analysis, and secret admin override capabilities for the Backwoods Survival Index.
 * ========================================================================================
 */
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { 
  Compass, 
  RotateCw, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Sparkles, 
  Play, 
  Pause, 
  Zap, 
  Check, 
  Radio, 
  Layers, 
  Gauge, 
  Sliders, 
  Maximize2 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  getLiveRadiansState, 
  subscribeRadiansState, 
  broadcastRadiansUpdate, 
  CelestialRadiansState, 
  DEFAULT_RADIANS_STATE 
} from '../../utils/radiansSync';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface LiveRadiansTabProps {
  visitorId: string;
}

const PRESETS = [
  { label: 'Authentic Celestial Drift', speed: 0.000075, tag: '0.000075 rad/s' },
  { label: 'Steady Planetary Orbit', speed: 0.002, tag: '0.002000 rad/s' },
  { label: 'High-Velocity Celestial Spin', speed: 0.015, tag: '0.015000 rad/s' },
  { label: 'Warp Streaks (Motion Blur)', speed: 0.05, tag: '0.050000 rad/s' },
  { label: 'Hyper-Speed Velocity (Max 5.0)', speed: 5.0, tag: '5.000000 rad/s' },
  { label: 'Stationary Celestial Zero', speed: 0, tag: '0.000000 rad/s' },
];

export default function LiveRadiansTab({ visitorId }: LiveRadiansTabProps) {
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const [state, setState] = useState<CelestialRadiansState>(getLiveRadiansState);
  const [inputSpeed, setInputSpeed] = useState<string>(() => state.angularSpeed.toFixed(6));
  const [liveAngle, setLiveAngle] = useState<number>(0);
  const [recentSyncBadge, setRecentSyncBadge] = useState<boolean>(false);
  
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const angleRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastFrameTimeRef = useRef<number>(performance.now());
  const stateRef = useRef<CelestialRadiansState>(state);

  // Keep stateRef in sync with state for zero-lag RAF loop
  useEffect(() => {
    stateRef.current = state;
    setInputSpeed(state.angularSpeed.toFixed(6));
  }, [state]);

  // Subscribe to real-time broadcasts
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = subscribeRadiansState((newState) => {
      setState(newState);
      setRecentSyncBadge(true);
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setRecentSyncBadge(false), 1200);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  // Real-time canvas radar sweep loop
  useEffect(() => {
    let animId: number;

    const renderDial = (currentTime: number) => {
      const dt = Math.min((currentTime - lastFrameTimeRef.current) / 1000, 0.1);
      lastFrameTimeRef.current = currentTime;

      const currentSpeed = stateRef.current.isPaused ? 0 : stateRef.current.angularSpeed;
      angleRef.current = (angleRef.current + currentSpeed * dt) % (Math.PI * 2);
      if (angleRef.current < 0) angleRef.current += Math.PI * 2;

      setLiveAngle(angleRef.current);

      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      if (canvas) {
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (ctx) {
          const w = canvas.width;
          const h = canvas.height;
          const cx = w / 2;
          const cy = h / 2;
          const radius = Math.min(w, h) * 0.42;

          ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

          // Radar background glow
          const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 5, cx, cy, radius);
          bgGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08)');
          bgGrad.addColorStop(0.8, 'rgba(6, 78, 59, 0.04)');
          bgGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();

          // Outer concentric grid rings
          [0.35, 0.65, 1.0].forEach((ratio, idx) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * ratio, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.strokeStyle = idx === 2 ? 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.45)' : 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15)';
            ctx.lineWidth = idx === 2 ? 1.5 : 1;
            ctx.setLineDash(idx === 1 ? [4, 4] : []);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
          });

          // Cardinal coordinate axes
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(cx - radius * 1.05, cy);
          ctx.lineTo(cx + radius * 1.05, cy);
          ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - radius * 1.05);
          ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + radius * 1.05);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.2)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Radian tick marks around perimeter (16 sectors = π/8 intervals)
          const totalTicks = 16;
          for (let i = 0; i < totalTicks; i++) {
            const rad = (i * Math.PI * 2) / totalTicks;
            const isMajor = i % 4 === 0;
            const isSemi = i % 2 === 0;
            const tickLen = isMajor ? 9 : isSemi ? 6 : 3;

            const x1 = cx + Math.cos(rad) * radius;
            const y1 = cy + Math.sin(rad) * radius;
            const x2 = cx + Math.cos(rad) * (radius - tickLen);
            const y2 = cy + Math.sin(rad) * (radius - tickLen);

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
            ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
            ctx.strokeStyle = isMajor ? 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.8)' : 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.3)';
            ctx.lineWidth = isMajor ? 1.5 : 1;
            ctx.stroke();
          }

          // Rotating Sweep Reticle (indicates active live angular position)
          const sweepAngle = angleRef.current;
          const sweepX = cx + Math.cos(sweepAngle) * radius;
          const sweepY = cy + Math.sin(sweepAngle) * radius;

          // Sweep trail cone
          const sweepTrailSteps = 24;
          for (let step = 0; step < sweepTrailSteps; step++) {
            const tRatio = step / sweepTrailSteps;
            const trailAngle = sweepAngle - (tRatio * 0.5 * Math.sign(currentSpeed || 1));
            const alpha = (1 - tRatio) * 0.25;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
            ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, trailAngle, trailAngle + 0.02 * Math.sign(currentSpeed || 1));
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(16, 185, 129, ${alpha})`;
            ctx.fill();
          }

          // Main needle line
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
          ctx.lineTo(sweepX, sweepY);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.95)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Target reticle head
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(sweepX, sweepY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#34d399';
          ctx.shadowColor = '#10b981';
          ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

          // Center anchor pivot
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(cx, cy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#34d399';
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }

      animId = requestAnimationFrame(renderDial);
    };

    animId = requestAnimationFrame(renderDial);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
  }, []);

  const handleSpeedChange = useCallback((newSpeed: number) => {
    broadcastRadiansUpdate({ angularSpeed: newSpeed }, visitorId);
  }, [visitorId]);

  const handleManualInputSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const val = parseFloat(inputSpeed);
    if (!isNaN(val)) {
      const clamped = Math.max(-5.0, Math.min(5.0, val));
      handleSpeedChange(clamped);
    }
  };

  const handleNudgePhase = (deltaRad: number) => {
    angleRef.current = (angleRef.current + deltaRad) % (Math.PI * 2);
    if (angleRef.current < 0) angleRef.current += Math.PI * 2;
    setLiveAngle(angleRef.current);
    broadcastRadiansUpdate({ phaseOffset: angleRef.current }, visitorId);
  };

  const degreesPerSec = (state.angularSpeed * (180 / Math.PI)).toFixed(2);
  const rpm = ((state.angularSpeed * 60) / (Math.PI * 2)).toFixed(3);

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0 overflow-y-auto gap-3 text-[#cbd5e1] font-mono select-none pr-1">
      {/* Top Protocol Status Bar */}
      <div className="shrink-0 p-2 sm:p-2.5 bg-[#090f0c] border border-[#1b261e] rounded flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="flex h-2 w-2 relative">
            <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-75" />
            <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-emerald-500" />
          </span>
          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px]">
            LIVE RADIANS BROADCAST BUS
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#4f6454] hidden sm:inline">|</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#637d68] hidden sm:inline">
            SYNCHRONIZED VIA FIRESTORE CLUSTER
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {recentSyncBadge && (
            <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-950/80 border border-emerald-700/80 text-emerald-300 animate-pulse">
              PACKET RECEIVED
            </span>
          )}
          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#4f6454]">
            NODE: <span className="text-emerald-300 font-semibold">{state.updatedBy || 'SYSTEM'}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Grid: Radar Scope (Left) + Master Controllers (Right) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-3 min-h-0">
        {/* Left Column: Live Gyroscope Radar Dial & Telemetric Vector */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-[#0a0f0c] border border-[#18231a] rounded p-3 flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#18231a] pb-1.5 text-[10px] uppercase text-[#637d68] tracking-wider">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Compass className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>RADIAN RADAR RETICLE</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">
              θ = {liveAngle.toFixed(4)} rad
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Interactive Radar Canvas */}
          <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center p-2">
            <canvas 
              ref={canvasRef} 
              width={240} 
              height={240} 
              className="w-52 h-52 sm:w-56 sm:h-56 rounded-full border border-emerald-900/30 bg-[#060a08] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.06)]"
            />
            {/* Overlay cardinal markers */}
            <span className="absolute top-3 text-[9px] font-bold text-emerald-400/80">0 rad / N</span>
            <span className="absolute right-3 text-[9px] font-bold text-emerald-400/80">π/2 rad</span>
            <span className="absolute bottom-3 text-[9px] font-bold text-emerald-400/80">π rad / S</span>
            <span className="absolute left-3 text-[9px] font-bold text-emerald-400/80">3π/2 rad</span>
          </div>

          {/* Telemetry Metrics Readout */}
          <div className="w-full grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 text-center bg-[#070b08] p-2 rounded border border-[#141d16] text-[10px]">
            <div>
              <div className="text-[#4f6454] text-[8.5px] uppercase">ANGULAR VELOCITY</div>
              <div className="text-emerald-300 font-bold text-[11px] font-mono">
                {state.angularSpeed >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{state.angularSpeed.toFixed(6)}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[8px] text-[#4f6454]">rad / sec</div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-[#4f6454] text-[8.5px] uppercase">ARC ROTATION</div>
              <div className="text-cyan-300 font-bold text-[11px] font-mono">
                {degreesPerSec}°/s
              </div>

                  state.isPaused 
                    ? 'bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-300 border border-amber-800'

              >

                return (

                    className={`p-2 rounded text-left border transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between gap-1 ${

                        : 'bg-[#070b08] border-[#162018] hover:border-emerald-800/80 hover:bg-[#0c130e]'
                    }`}
                  >

                      {p.label}

                      {p.tag}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}

          </div>

          {/* Phase Nudge & Auxiliary Drift Controls */}
          <div className="bg-[#0a0f0c] border border-[#18231a] rounded p-3 flex flex-col gap-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#18231a] pb-1">

              </span>

            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleNudgePhase(-Math.PI / 2)}
                className="px-2 py-1 bg-[#070b08] hover:bg-[#101812] border border-[#1a251d] hover:border-emerald-700/60 rounded text-[9.5px] text-[#8eb397] font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                -π/2 (-90°)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleNudgePhase(-Math.PI / 4)}
                className="px-2 py-1 bg-[#070b08] hover:bg-[#101812] border border-[#1a251d] hover:border-emerald-700/60 rounded text-[9.5px] text-[#8eb397] font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                -π/4 (-45°)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleNudgePhase(Math.PI / 4)}
                className="px-2 py-1 bg-[#070b08] hover:bg-[#101812] border border-[#1a251d] hover:border-emerald-700/60 rounded text-[9.5px] text-[#8eb397] font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                +π/4 (+45°)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleNudgePhase(Math.PI / 2)}
                className="px-2 py-1 bg-[#070b08] hover:bg-[#101812] border border-[#1a251d] hover:border-emerald-700/60 rounded text-[9.5px] text-[#8eb397] font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                +π/2 (+90°)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleNudgePhase(Math.PI)}
                className="px-2 py-1 bg-[#070b08] hover:bg-[#101812] border border-[#1a251d] hover:border-emerald-700/60 rounded text-[9.5px] text-[#8eb397] font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                +π (+180°)
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  angleRef.current = 0;
                  setLiveAngle(0);
                  broadcastRadiansUpdate({ phaseOffset: 0 }, visitorId);
                }}
                className="px-2 py-1 bg-red-950/40 hover:bg-red-950/80 border border-red-900/60 rounded text-[9.5px] text-red-300 font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer ml-auto"
              >
                ZERO (0 rad)
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Theme switcher banner if theme is not Starlight */}
            {theme !== 'starlight' && (
              <div className="mt-1 p-2 bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-900/50 rounded flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] text-amber-300">
                <span>The background sky theme is currently set to Emerald. Switch to Starlight to see the live rotation in the background.</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTheme('starlight')}
                  className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-900/60 hover:bg-amber-800 text-amber-100 rounded text-[9px] font-bold uppercase transition-colors shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  ACTIVATE STARLIGHT
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
