                              <span className="sm:hidden">Trace Stream</span>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </span>
                        {searchResults !== null && (
                          <span className="text-[8px] sm:text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-cyan-950/70 border border-cyan-800 text-cyan-300 font-mono uppercase font-bold shrink-0">
                            HISTORICAL
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Filter Pills */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#090d0a] p-0.5 rounded border border-[#1b261e] shrink-0 self-start sm:self-auto">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setLogFilter('all')}
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                            logFilter === 'all'
                              ? 'bg-[#1b261e] text-[#d6ded7] border border-[#2b3c30]'
                              : 'text-[#4f6454] hover:text-[#a4c9ad]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          All ({activeLogsPool.length})
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setLogFilter('unique')}
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                            logFilter === 'unique'
                              ? 'bg-emerald-950/70 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-800'
                              : 'text-[#4f6454] hover:text-emerald-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          Unique ({activeLogsPool.filter(l => l.type === 'unique').length})
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setLogFilter('repeat')}
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                            logFilter === 'repeat'
                              ? 'bg-amber-950/70 text-amber-300 border border-amber-800'
                              : 'text-[#4f6454] hover:text-amber-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          Return ({activeLogsPool.filter(l => l.type === 'repeat').length})
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setLogFilter('click')}
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                            logFilter === 'click'
                              ? 'bg-purple-950/70 text-purple-300 border border-purple-800'
                              : 'text-[#4f6454] hover:text-purple-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          Clicks ({activeLogsPool.filter(l => l.type === 'click').length})
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Optimized User ID Search Engine */}
                    <div className="relative mb-2 shrink-0">
                      <div className="relative flex items-center">
                        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-[#5e7564] absolute left-2.5 pointer-events-none" />
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={searchUserId}
                          onChange={(e) => setSearchUserId(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="Search User ID, device/OS (e.g. Linux, Windows), or node..."
                          className="w-full bg-[#080d0a] border border-[#1b261e] focus:border-emerald-600/70 focus:outline-none text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-mono text-[#d6ded7] placeholder-[#4f6454] pl-8.5 pr-20 py-1.5 rounded transition-all"
                        />
                        {searchUserId ? (
                          <div className="absolute right-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            {isSearching && (
                              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-400 border-t-transparent animate-spin" />
                            )}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setSearchUserId('');
                                setSearchResults(null);
                                setSearchSummary(null);
                              }}
                              className="text-[#5e7564] hover:text-[#d6ded7] transition-colors p-0.5 cursor-pointer"
                              title="Clear search"
                            >
                              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setSearchUserId(currentVisitorIdShort)}
                            className="absolute right-1.5 text-[8.5px] sm:text-[9.5px] text-[#5e7564] hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors uppercase font-mono px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#0e1611] rounded border border-[#1c271f] cursor-pointer"
                            title="Audit history for your current browser node"
                          >
                            My Node
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Search Result Intelligence Card */}
                    {searchUserId.trim() && (
                      <div className="mb-2 bg-[#080d0a] border border-[#1b261e] rounded p-2 text-[9.5px] sm:text-[10px] font-mono select-none shrink-0">
                        {isSearching ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-400 py-0.5">
                            <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-400 border-t-transparent animate-spin" />
                            <span>Querying Firestore history for "{searchUserId}"...</span>
                          </div>
                        ) : searchResults && searchResults.length > 0 ? (
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-[#141d16] pb-1">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-300 font-semibold">
                                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
                                <span>AUDIT: {searchResults.length} RECORDS FOUND</span>
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-[8px] sm:text-[8.5px] text-[#55695a]">
                                {searchSummary?.matchedNodes.length} NODE(S) MATCHED
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-[8px] sm:text-[8.5px] text-[#7a9480]">
                              {searchSummary?.oldestDate && (
                                <span>
                                  FIRST: <strong className="text-[#a4c9ad]">{new Date(searchSummary.oldestDate).toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}</strong>
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {searchSummary?.newestDate && (
                                <span>
                                  LATEST: <strong className="text-[#a4c9ad]">{new Date(searchSummary.newestDate).toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}</strong>
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {searchSummary?.topTarget && (
                                <span>
                                  TOP: <strong className="text-emerald-400">{searchSummary.topTarget.title} ({searchSummary.topTarget.count}x)</strong>
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {searchSummary?.device && (
                                <span>
                                  PLATFORM: <strong className="text-emerald-300 font-semibold">{searchSummary.device}</strong>
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="text-[#687f6e] italic py-0.5">
                            No records found in database history matching "{searchUserId}".
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Scrollable Log Stream */}
                    <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 sm:space-y-2 pr-1 pb-2 font-mono scrollbar-thin">
                      {filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-center py-10 text-[#4f6454] italic">
                          <Radio className="w-4 h-4 mb-1 text-[#303f34]" />
                          <span className="text-xs">No telemetry trace events match the active criteria.</span>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        filteredLogs.map((log, index) => {
                          const date = new Date(log.timestamp);
                          const timeOnly = date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: false });
                          const isNew = log.type === 'unique';
                          const relativeTime = formatRelativeTime(log.timestamp);
                          const isCurrentVisitor = log.visitorId === currentVisitorIdShort;
                          const displayBrowser = log.browser || (isCurrentVisitor ? clientEnv.browser : null);
                          const displayOs = log.os || (isCurrentVisitor ? clientEnv.os : null);
                          const display = formatLogDisplay(log);

                          return (
                            <div 
                              key={`${log.timestamp}-${index}`} 
                              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-[#080c09] hover:bg-[#101712] border border-[#162018] rounded transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-2 min-h-[32px] text-[10px] sm:text-[11px]"
                            >
                              {/* Left: Timestamp, Type Badge, Target Action */}
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">
                                {/* Monospace Timestamp */}
                                <span className="text-[#4e6453] text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-semibold shrink-0" title={date.toLocaleString()}>
                                  [{timeOnly}]
                                </span>

                                {/* Categorized Badge */}
                                {log.type === 'click' ? (
                                  <span className="shrink-0 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[7.5px] sm:text-[8px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider bg-purple-950/80 text-purple-300 border border-purple-700/80">
                                    CLK
                                  </span>
                                ) : log.slug === 'telemetry-terminal' ? (
                                  <span className="shrink-0 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[7.5px] sm:text-[8px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider bg-cyan-950/80 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-800/80">
                                    TERM
                                  </span>
                                ) : isNew ? (
                                  <span className="shrink-0 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[7.5px] sm:text-[8px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider bg-emerald-950/80 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-700/80">
                                    NEW
                                  </span>
                                ) : (
                                  <span className="shrink-0 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[7.5px] sm:text-[8px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider bg-[#1c180a] text-amber-300 border border-amber-800/80">
                                    RET
                                  </span>
                                )}

                                {/* Destination Title */}
                                <span className="text-[#c8d8cb] hover:text-emerald-300 transition-colors truncate font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                                  {log.type === 'click' ? (
                                    <MousePointerClick className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400 shrink-0 inline" />
                                  ) : log.slug === 'telemetry-terminal' ? (
                                    <Terminal className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400 shrink-0 inline" />
                                  ) : null}
                                  <span className="truncate">{display.main}</span>
                                  {display.sub && (
                                    <span className="text-[#556e5d] text-[9px] shrink-0 font-normal">
                                      · {display.sub}
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                </span>
                              </div>

                              {/* Right: Device Pill, Visitor Node Chip, Relative Time */}
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 shrink-0">
                                {/* Inline Device Pill (Clickable Filter) */}
                                {(displayBrowser || displayOs) && (
                                  <div 
                                    onClick={() => setSearchUserId(displayOs || displayBrowser || 'Linux')}
                                    title={`Click to filter complete database history for ${displayOs || displayBrowser}`}
                                    className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[8px] sm:text-[8.5px] text-[#5e7765] hover:text-emerald-300 bg-[#0c120e] hover:bg-[#121c15] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-[#162017] hover:border-emerald-700/60 transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none group"
                                  >
                                    <Monitor className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-emerald-500/70 group-hover:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 truncate max-w-[130px]">
                                      {displayBrowser && (
                                        <button
                                          type="button"
                                          onClick={(e) => {
                                            e.stopPropagation();
                                            setSearchUserId(displayBrowser);
                                          }}
                                          title={`Filter complete history for browser: ${displayBrowser}`}
                                          className="hover:text-emerald-300 hover:underline cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                                        >
                                          {displayBrowser}
                                        </button>
                                      )}
                                      {displayBrowser && displayOs && (
                                        <span className="text-[#324536] text-[7.5px]">·</span>
                                      )}
                                      {displayOs && (
                                        <button
                                          type="button"
                                          onClick={(e) => {
                                            e.stopPropagation();
                                            setSearchUserId(displayOs);
                                          }}
                                          title={`Filter complete history for OS: ${displayOs}`}
                                          className="font-medium text-[#7a9d82] hover:text-emerald-300 hover:underline cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                                        >
                                          {displayOs}
                                        </button>
                                      )}
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                )}

                                {/* Visitor Node Chip */}
                                {isCurrentVisitor ? (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => setSearchUserId(log.visitorId)}
                                    title="Click to search full database history for your node"
                                    className="text-[8.5px] sm:text-[9px] text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-950/60 px-1.5 sm:px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-700/60 font-mono font-semibold hover:bg-emerald-900/80 hover:border-emerald-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  >
                                    {log.visitorId} <span className="hidden sm:inline">(YOU)</span>
                                  </button>
                                ) : (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => setSearchUserId(log.visitorId)}
                                    title={`Click to search complete database history for node ${log.visitorId}`}
                                    className="text-[8.5px] sm:text-[9px] text-[#637d68] bg-[#0d140f] px-1.5 sm:px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-[#1c271f] font-mono hover:text-emerald-400 hover:border-[#2f3f33] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  >
                                    {log.visitorId}
                                  </button>
                                )}

                                {/* Elapsed Time */}
                                <span className="text-[#415546] shrink-0 text-[8px] sm:text-[8.5px] font-mono min-w-[34px] text-right">
                                  {relativeTime}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-12 text-[#4f6454] italic">
                System awaiting first scan.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Moon } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';

interface ThemeToggleProps {
  className?: string;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
}

function ThemeToggle({ className = '', size = 'md' }: ThemeToggleProps) {
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const isStarlight = theme === 'starlight';

  const sizeClasses = size === 'sm' ? 'w-8 h-8 p-1.5' : 'w-8 h-8 p-1.5';

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={toggleTheme}
      id="theme-toggle-button"
      className={`relative ${sizeClasses} rounded border transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer group shrink-0 ${
        isStarlight
          ? 'bg-neutral-900 border-zinc-700 text-zinc-100 hover:bg-neutral-800 hover:border-zinc-500 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(255,255,255,0.12)]'
          : 'bg-[#182119] border-[#2d3a2f] text-[#a9d1b0] hover:bg-[#212f23] hover:border-[#425545]'
      } ${className}`}
      title={
        isStarlight
          ? 'Active Theme: Starlight Obsidian (Click to switch to Emerald Forest)'
          : 'Active Theme: Emerald Forest (Click to switch to Starlight Obsidian)'
      }
      aria-label="Toggle Theme"
    >
      {isStarlight ? (
        <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-200 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-200" />
      ) : (
        <Moon className="w-4 h-4 text-[#a9d1b0] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-200" />
      )}
      <span className="sr-only">Toggle theme</span>
    </button>
  );
}

export default React.memo(ThemeToggle);

export interface WikiOption {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  url?: string;
}

export const WIKI_OPTIONS: WikiOption[] = [
  {
    id: 'backwoods',
    title: 'BACKWOODS',
    url: '#/wiki/home'
  },
  {
    id: 'super_bonemeal',
    title: 'SUPER BONEMEAL',
    url: 'https://honeypie3301.github.io/Super-Bonemeal-Wiki/'
  },
  {
    id: 'darwinism',
    title: 'DARWINISM',
    url: 'https://honeypie3301.github.io/Darwinism-Wiki/#/wiki/home'
  }
];

export default function TitleDialPicker() {
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<number>(0);
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const dragStartY = useRef<number>(0);
  const dragStartPos = useRef<number>(0);
  const animFrameId = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const resetTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const isSettling = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const isAutoResetting = useRef<boolean>(false);

  const itemHeight = 52;
  const viewportHeight = 56;

  // Reset to Backwoods (0) on mount, focus, pageshow, popstate, or visibilitychange
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleReset = () => {
      if (animFrameId.current) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameId.current);
        animFrameId.current = null;
      }
      if (resetTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(resetTimeoutRef.current);
        resetTimeoutRef.current = null;
      }
      isSettling.current = false;
      isAutoResetting.current = false;
      setIsDragging(false);
      setPosition(0);
      setSelectedIndex(0);
    };

    handleReset();

    const handleVisibility = () => {
      if (!document.hidden) {
        handleReset();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('pageshow', handleReset);
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleReset);
    window.addEventListener('popstate', handleReset);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleReset);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pageshow', handleReset);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleReset);
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', handleReset);
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', handleReset);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
      if (animFrameId.current) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameId.current);
      }
      if (resetTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(resetTimeoutRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const animateToTarget = useCallback((targetIndex: number, shouldTriggerSettle: boolean = true) => {
    if (animFrameId.current) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameId.current);
    }

    isSettling.current = true;

    const step = () => {
      setPosition(prev => {
        const diff = targetIndex - prev;
        if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.005) {
          isSettling.current = false;
          setSelectedIndex(targetIndex);
          if (shouldTriggerSettle) {
            handleSettleOption(targetIndex);
          }
          return targetIndex;
        }
        return prev + diff * 0.22;
      });

      if (isSettling.current) {
        animFrameId.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
    };

    animFrameId.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const handleSettleOption = useCallback((index: number) => {
    if (isAutoResetting.current) {
      isAutoResetting.current = false;
      return;
    }

    const targetOption = WIKI_OPTIONS[index];
    if (!targetOption) return;

    if (index !== 0) {
      // 1. If option has a URL (e.g. Super Bonemeal), redirect to it
      if (targetOption.url) {
        window.location.href = targetOption.url;
      }

      // 2. Animate dial back to BACKWOODS (0) smoothly
      if (resetTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(resetTimeoutRef.current);
      }
      resetTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        isAutoResetting.current = true;
        animateToTarget(0, false);
      }, 350);
    } else {
      if (window.location.hash !== '#/wiki/home' && window.location.hash !== '') {
        window.location.hash = '#/wiki/home';
      }
    }
  }, [animateToTarget]);

  const handleDragEnd = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    setIsDragging(false);

    setPosition(currentPos => {
      const targetIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(WIKI_OPTIONS.length - 1, Math.round(currentPos)));
      animateToTarget(targetIndex, true);
      return currentPos;
    });
  }, [isDragging, animateToTarget]);

  const handlePointerDown = (clientY: number) => {
    if (animFrameId.current) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameId.current);
    }
    isAutoResetting.current = false;

    setIsDragging(true);
    dragStartY.current = clientY;
    dragStartPos.current = position;
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (clientY: number) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    const deltaY = clientY - dragStartY.current;
    const posDelta = -deltaY / itemHeight;
    const rawPos = dragStartPos.current + posDelta;

    let boundedPos = rawPos;
    if (rawPos < 0) {
      boundedPos = rawPos * 0.3;
    } else if (rawPos > WIKI_OPTIONS.length - 1) {
      boundedPos = (WIKI_OPTIONS.length - 1) + (rawPos - (WIKI_OPTIONS.length - 1)) * 0.3;
    }

    setPosition(boundedPos);
  };

  const onMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    handlePointerDown(e.clientY);
  };

  const onTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (e.touches.length === 1) {
      handlePointerDown(e.touches[0].clientY);
    }
  };

  const onTouchMove = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (isDragging && e.touches.length === 1) {
      handlePointerMove(e.touches[0].clientY);
    }
  };

  const onTouchEnd = () => {
    handleDragEnd();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const onGlobalMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (isDragging) handlePointerMove(e.clientY);
    };

    const onGlobalMouseUp = () => {
      if (isDragging) handleDragEnd();
    };

    if (isDragging) {
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onGlobalMouseMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onGlobalMouseUp);
    }

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onGlobalMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onGlobalMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDragging, handleDragEnd]);

  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (isDragging) return;

    if (animFrameId.current) cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameId.current);
    isAutoResetting.current = false;

    const delta = e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    const nextIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(WIKI_OPTIONS.length - 1, selectedIndex + delta));
    if (nextIndex !== selectedIndex) {
      animateToTarget(nextIndex, true);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (animFrameId.current) cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameId.current);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onMouseDown={onMouseDown}
      onTouchStart={onTouchStart}
      onTouchMove={onTouchMove}
      onTouchEnd={onTouchEnd}
      onWheel={handleWheel}
      style={{ height: `${viewportHeight}px` }}
      className="relative overflow-hidden cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing select-none touch-none flex items-center justify-center w-full"
    >
      <div
        className="relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center"
        style={{ perspective: '400px', transformStyle: 'preserve-3d' }}
      >
        {WIKI_OPTIONS.map((opt, idx) => {
          const offset = idx - position;
          const absOffset = Math.abs(offset);

          if (absOffset > 2.0) return null;

          const translateY = offset * itemHeight;
          const rotateX = -offset * 35;
          const scale = Math.max(0.7, 1 - absOffset * 0.15);
          const opacity = Math.max(0, 1 - absOffset * 0.85);
          const isCenter = absOffset < 0.35;

          return (
            <h1
              key={opt.id}
              onClick={() => {
                if (!isDragging && idx !== selectedIndex) {
                  animateToTarget(idx, true);
                }
              }}
              style={{
                height: `${itemHeight}px`,
                transform: `translateY(${translateY}px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) scale(${scale})`,
                opacity: opacity,
                zIndex: Math.round(10 - absOffset * 2)
              }}
              className={`
                absolute left-0 right-0 flex items-center justify-center px-1 text-center
                font-serif text-[clamp(1.5rem,5.5vw,3rem)] font-extrabold tracking-[clamp(0.04em,1vw,0.18em)] uppercase transition-all duration-75 whitespace-nowrap select-none
                ${isCenter ? 'text-[#e0e7e0]' : 'text-[#709978]'}
              `}
            >
              {opt.title}
            </h1>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * IMPORTANT FOR AI ASSISTANTS / DEVELOPERS:
 * When adding or editing wiki components, wrap new/changed elements in <UpdatedFrame id="unique_feature_id" isUpdated={true}>.
 * DON'T FORGET: Whenever you update wiki content, you MUST also update the "Wiki Maintenance & Version Update Note"
 * in `HomeView.tsx` with the latest feature/commit highlights.
 * Rule: Only underline "The wiki is always updated before a new version releases."
 */
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';

interface UpdatedFrameProps {
  id: string; // Unique identifier for localStorage tracking
  children: React.ReactNode;
  isUpdated?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  badgeLabel?: string;
  key?: React.Key;
}

export default function UpdatedFrame({
  id,
  children,
  isUpdated = true,
  className = '',
  badgeLabel = 'UPDATED'
}: UpdatedFrameProps) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();

  const [active, setActive] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (!isUpdated) return false;
    try {
      const seen = localStorage.getItem(`backwoods_updated_seen_${id}`);
      return seen !== 'true';
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  });

  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Monitor visibility using IntersectionObserver
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setIsVisible(true);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0 }
    );

    if (containerRef.current) {
      observer.observe(containerRef.current);
    }

    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [active]);

  // Permanently mark as seen IMMEDIATELY when shown on user screen
  useEffect(() => {
    if (active && isVisible) {
      // Instantly mark as seen in localStorage so it is NEVER shown on subsequent sessions/views
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(`backwoods_updated_seen_${id}`, 'true');
      } catch (e) {
        // Ignore sandbox restriction errors
      }

      // Hide badge/border after 7-second grace period for current view
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setActive(false);
      }, 7000);

      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [active, isVisible, id]);

  const isStarlight = theme === 'starlight';

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`relative transition-all duration-700 ${
        isStarlight
          ? active
            ? 'z-20 border border-zinc-400/70 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(228,228,231,0.25)] rounded-xl animate-pulse'
            : ''
          : active
            ? 'z-20 border border-amber-500/50 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,158,11,0.25)] rounded-xl'
            : ''
      } ${className}`}
    >
      {active && (
        <div
          className={`absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 z-30 font-mono text-[9px] font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 pointer-events-none select-none ${
            isStarlight
              ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-600 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(228,228,231,0.25)]'
              : 'bg-amber-500/90 text-[#0f110d] border border-amber-300/40'
          }`}
        >
          <span
            className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
              isStarlight ? 'bg-zinc-950 animate-ping' : 'bg-amber-200'
            }`}
          />
          <span>{badgeLabel}</span>
          <span className="text-[8px] opacity-75 font-normal">(7s)</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';

export type WikiTheme = 'emerald' | 'starlight';

interface ThemeContextType {
  theme: WikiTheme;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  setTheme: (theme: WikiTheme) => void;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType>({
  theme: 'emerald',
  toggleTheme: () => {},
  setTheme: () => {},
});

const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'backwoods_wiki_theme';

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<WikiTheme>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved === 'starlight' || saved === 'emerald') {
        return saved;
      }
    } catch {
      // Fallback if localStorage is restricted
    }
    return 'emerald';
  });

  const setTheme = useCallback((newTheme: WikiTheme) => {
    setThemeState(newTheme);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, newTheme);
    } catch {
      // Ignore quota errors
    }
  }, []);

  const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    setThemeState((prev) => {
      const nextTheme = prev === 'emerald' ? 'starlight' : 'emerald';
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, nextTheme);
      } catch {
        // Ignore quota errors
      }
      return nextTheme;
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const contextValue = useMemo<ThemeContextType>(() => ({
    theme,
    toggleTheme,
    setTheme,
  }), [theme, toggleTheme, setTheme]);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  return useContext(ThemeContext);
}

export interface ClientEnvironment {
  os: string;
  browser: string;
  deviceType: 'Desktop' | 'Mobile' | 'Tablet';
  summary: string;
  osVersion?: string;
  browserVersion?: string;
}

export function detectClientEnvironment(customUserAgent?: string): ClientEnvironment {
  const nav = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator : null;
  const ua = customUserAgent || (nav ? nav.userAgent : '') || '';
  const uaData = (nav as unknown as { userAgentData?: {
    platform?: string;
    mobile?: boolean;
    brands?: Array<{ brand: string; version: string }>;
  } })?.userAgentData;

  let os = 'Unknown OS';
  let osVersion = '';
  let browser = 'Unknown Browser';
  let browserVersion = '';
  let deviceType: 'Desktop' | 'Mobile' | 'Tablet' = 'Desktop';

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 1. Operating System Detection
  // ----------------------------------------------------

  // iPadOS Detection (iOS 13+ iPad Safari masks as macOS desktop: "Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7")
  const isIpadOS = /iPad/i.test(ua) || (
    /Macintosh|Mac OS X/i.test(ua) &&
    Boolean(nav && typeof nav.maxTouchPoints === 'number' && nav.maxTouchPoints > 1)
  );

  if (isIpadOS) {
    os = 'iPadOS';
    const match = ua.match(/OS (\d+[._]\d+)/i);
    if (match) osVersion = match[1].replace(/_/g, '.');
  } else if (/iPhone/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'iOS';
    const match = ua.match(/OS (\d+[._]\d+)/i);
    if (match) osVersion = match[1].replace(/_/g, '.');
  } else if (/iPod/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'iOS (iPod)';
    const match = ua.match(/OS (\d+[._]\d+)/i);
    if (match) osVersion = match[1].replace(/_/g, '.');
  } else if (/Windows Phone/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Windows Phone';
    const match = ua.match(/Windows Phone (\d+[._]\d+)/i);
    if (match) osVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/Windows/i.test(ua) || uaData?.platform === 'Windows') {
    // Windows version extraction
    if (/Windows NT 10.0/i.test(ua)) {
      // Modern Windows 11 sends Windows NT 10.0 in UA string
      // But can be verified via Client Hints or marked as modern Windows
      os = 'Windows 10/11';
    } else if (/Windows NT 6.3/i.test(ua)) {
      os = 'Windows 8.1';
    } else if (/Windows NT 6.2/i.test(ua)) {
      os = 'Windows 8';
    } else if (/Windows NT 6.1/i.test(ua)) {
      os = 'Windows 7';
    } else if (/Windows NT 6.0/i.test(ua)) {
      os = 'Windows Vista';
    } else if (/Windows NT 5.1|Windows XP/i.test(ua)) {
      os = 'Windows XP';
    } else if (/Windows NT 5.0|Windows 2000/i.test(ua)) {
      os = 'Windows 2000';
    } else {
      os = 'Windows';
    }
  } else if (/Macintosh|Mac OS X/i.test(ua) || uaData?.platform === 'macOS') {
    os = 'macOS';
    const match = ua.match(/Mac OS X (\d+[._]\d+[._]?\d*)/i);
    if (match) osVersion = match[1].replace(/_/g, '.');
  } else if (/HarmonyOS/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'HarmonyOS';
  } else if (/Android/i.test(ua) || uaData?.platform === 'Android') {
    os = 'Android';
    const match = ua.match(/Android (\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) osVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/CrOS/i.test(ua) || uaData?.platform === 'Chrome OS') {
    os = 'ChromeOS';
  } else if (/PlayStation 5/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'PlayStation 5';
  } else if (/PlayStation 4/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'PlayStation 4';
  } else if (/PlayStation/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'PlayStation';
  } else if (/Xbox/i.test(ua)) {
    if (/Xbox Series/i.test(ua)) os = 'Xbox Series X/S';
    else if (/Xbox One/i.test(ua)) os = 'Xbox One';
    else os = 'Xbox';
  } else if (/Nintendo Switch/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Nintendo Switch';
  } else if (/Nintendo 3DS|Nintendo WiiU/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Nintendo';
  } else if (/Oculus|Quest/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Meta Quest OS';
  } else if (/KaiOS/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'KaiOS';
  } else if (/FreeBSD/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'FreeBSD';
  } else if (/OpenBSD/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'OpenBSD';
  } else if (/NetBSD/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'NetBSD';
  } else if (/SunOS|Solaris/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Solaris';
  } else if (/Ubuntu/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Ubuntu Linux';
  } else if (/Debian/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Debian Linux';
  } else if (/Fedora/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Fedora Linux';
  } else if (/Arch/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Arch Linux';
  } else if (/Manjaro/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Manjaro Linux';
  } else if (/Mint/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Linux Mint';
  } else if (/CentOS/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'CentOS';
  } else if (/Red Hat|RHEL/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'Red Hat Linux';
  } else if (/SUSE/i.test(ua)) {
    os = 'SUSE Linux';
  } else if (/Linux/i.test(ua) || uaData?.platform === 'Linux') {
    os = 'Linux';
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 2. Browser Detection
  // (Order is strictly ordered from high specificity to generic Chromium/WebKit engines)
  // ----------------------------------------------------

  // Brave Check (Brave omits 'Brave' from UA in modern versions to combat fingerprinting)
  const isBrave = Boolean(
    (nav as unknown as { brave?: { isBrave?: () => Promise<boolean> | boolean } })?.brave !== undefined ||
    /Brave/i.test(ua) ||
    uaData?.brands?.some(b => b.brand === 'Brave')
  );

  if (isBrave) {
    browser = 'Brave';
  } else if (/Arc\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Arc';
    const match = ua.match(/Arc\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/SamsungBrowser\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Samsung Internet';
    const match = ua.match(/SamsungBrowser\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/DuckDuckGo\//i.test(ua) || /DDB\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'DuckDuckGo';
  } else if (/Opera GX|OPR\/.*GX/i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Opera GX';
    const match = ua.match(/OPR\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/OPR\/|Opera/i.test(ua) || /OPT\/|OPiOS\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Opera';
    const match = ua.match(/(?:OPR|Opera|OPT|OPiOS)[\/ ](\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/Edg\/|Edge\/|EdgA\/|EdgiOS\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Edge';
    const match = ua.match(/(?:Edg|Edge|EdgA|EdgiOS)\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/Vivaldi\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Vivaldi';
    const match = ua.match(/Vivaldi\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/YaBrowser\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Yandex Browser';
    const match = ua.match(/YaBrowser\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/UCBrowser\//i.test(ua) || /UBrowser\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'UC Browser';
    const match = ua.match(/(?:UCBrowser|UBrowser)\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/MiuiBrowser\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Miui Browser';
    const match = ua.match(/MiuiBrowser\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/HuaweiBrowser\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Huawei Browser';
    const match = ua.match(/HuaweiBrowser\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/MicroMessenger\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'WeChat';
  } else if (/QQBrowser|MQQBrowser/i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'QQ Browser';
  } else if (/Whale\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Naver Whale';
    const match = ua.match(/Whale\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/TorBrowser|Tor\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Tor Browser';
  } else if (/Waterfox\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Waterfox';
  } else if (/PaleMoon\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Pale Moon';
  } else if (/SeaMonkey\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'SeaMonkey';
  } else if (/FxiOS\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Firefox';
    const match = ua.match(/FxiOS\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/Firefox\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Firefox';
    const match = ua.match(/Firefox\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/CriOS\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Chrome';
    const match = ua.match(/CriOS\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/Chrome\//i.test(ua) && !/Chromium/i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Chrome';
    const match = ua.match(/Chrome\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/Chromium\//i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Chromium';
    const match = ua.match(/Chromium\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/HeadlessChrome/i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Headless Chrome';
  } else if (/Safari\//i.test(ua) && !/Chrome|CriOS|Android/i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Safari';
    const match = ua.match(/Version\/(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  } else if (/MSIE|Trident/i.test(ua)) {
    browser = 'Internet Explorer';
    const match = ua.match(/(?:MSIE |rv:)(\d+(\.\d+)*)/i);
    if (match) browserVersion = match[1];
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 3. Device Form Factor
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  if (
    isIpadOS ||
    /(tablet|ipad|playbook|silk)|(android(?!.*mobi))/i.test(ua) ||
    /Nexus (7|9|10)|SM-T|Galaxy Tab/i.test(ua)
  ) {
    deviceType = 'Tablet';
  } else if (
    /Mobile|Android|iP(hone|od)|IEMobile|BlackBerry|Kindle|Silk-Accelerated|KaiOS|webOS/i.test(ua) ||
    uaData?.mobile === true
  ) {
    deviceType = 'Mobile';
  } else {
    deviceType = 'Desktop';
  }

  const osDisplay = osVersion ? `${os} ${osVersion.split('.')[0]}` : os;
  const browserDisplay = browserVersion ? `${browser} ${browserVersion.split('.')[0]}` : browser;

  return {
    os,
    browser,
    deviceType,
    summary: `${browserDisplay} · ${osDisplay}`,
    osVersion,
    browserVersion
  };
}

/**
 * Utility functions for parsing MediaWiki and Wikitext syntax to standard HTML
 */

export function slugify(text: string): string {
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '');
}

export function parseWikiSyntax(content: string): string {
  if (!content) return '';

  let html = content;

  // --- THEME ALIGNMENT NORMALIZATION ---
  // Strip font-family overrides to guarantee we always use San Francisco (font-sans) or Playfair Display (font-serif)
  html = html.replace(/font-family:[^;"]+;?/gi, '');

  // Strip fixed outer backwoods-wiki-container styling to let the applet theme govern layout & background
  html = html.replace(/<div class="backwoods-wiki-container"[^>]*>/gi, '<div class="backwoods-wiki-container">');

  // Map red/orange accents and borders to cohesive, elegant sage and forest-green tones
  html = html.replace(/#ff7043/gi, '#a9d1b0'); // Orange accent -> Light mint green
  html = html.replace(/#d84315/gi, '#709978'); // Rust orange -> Sage green
  html = html.replace(/#7c1c1c/gi, '#709978'); // Crimson red -> Sage green
  html = html.replace(/#9e2a2a/gi, '#709978'); // Bright red -> Sage green
  html = html.replace(/#cf2a2a/gi, '#709978'); // Crimson -> Sage green
  html = html.replace(/#5c1414/gi, '#2e3e31'); // Blood red -> Forest green
  html = html.replace(/#401414/gi, '#1c241e'); // Dark red -> Deep forest green
  html = html.replace(/#301414/gi, '#1c241e'); // Dark red -> Deep forest green
  html = html.replace(/#201414/gi, '#151b16'); // Dark red -> Dark green-gray
  html = html.replace(/#1c1414/gi, '#151b16'); // Dark red -> Dark green-gray
  html = html.replace(/#1a1414/gi, '#151b16'); // Dark red -> Dark green-gray
  html = html.replace(/#321616/gi, '#1c241e'); // Deep red border -> Green-gray border
  html = html.replace(/#3c1414/gi, '#1c241e'); // Deep red border -> Green-gray border
  html = html.replace(/#1a1515/gi, '#151b16'); // Deep red border -> Green-gray border
  html = html.replace(/#1f1a1a/gi, '#151b16'); // Deep red border -> Green-gray border
  html = html.replace(/#222/gi, '#1a221c');    // Slate border -> Green-gray border

  // Purple accent mappings (The Still & dimension themes)
  html = html.replace(/#7e57c2/gi, '#8cd99d'); // Purple adaptive -> Muted mint green
  html = html.replace(/#ba68c8/gi, '#a9d1b0'); // Pink/Purple -> Light mint
  html = html.replace(/#4a2e80/gi, '#223226'); // Dark purple -> Dark green-gray

  // Convert reddish/brown backgrounds to beautiful deep forest/charcoal greens
  html = html.replace(/#120c0c/gi, '#0f1210'); // Dark red bg -> Forest slate bg
  html = html.replace(/#0d0909/gi, '#0f1210'); // Dark red bg -> Forest slate bg
  html = html.replace(/#0c0c0c/gi, '#0c0f0d'); // Card bg -> Solid dark slate bg
  html = html.replace(/#0b0b0b/gi, '#0c0f0d'); // Container bg -> Solid dark slate bg
  html = html.replace(/#080808/gi, '#080a08'); // Main bg -> Our deep dark background
  html = html.replace(/#111111/gi, '#0f1210'); // Soft black -> Forest slate
  html = html.replace(/#111/gi, '#0f1210');    // Soft black -> Forest slate
  html = html.replace(/#0f0f0f/gi, '#0c0f0d'); // Muted black -> Card bg

  // RGBA translucent overlays
  html = html.replace(/rgba\(25,\s*20,\s*20,\s*0\.8\)/gi, 'rgba(15, 20, 16, 0.95)');
  html = html.replace(/rgba\(40,\s*25,\s*20,\s*0\.6\)/gi, 'rgba(12, 17, 13, 0.9)');
  html = html.replace(/rgba\(30,\s*25,\s*45,\s*0\.5\)/gi, 'rgba(15, 25, 18, 0.7)');
  html = html.replace(/rgba\(26,\s*21,\s*37,\s*0\.5\)/gi, 'rgba(15, 25, 18, 0.7)');

  // Normalize text body and secondary label colors
  html = html.replace(/#c4bfa5/gi, '#c9d1c9'); // Muted beige -> Sleek light sage-gray
  html = html.replace(/#e0dcd3/gi, '#c9d1c9'); // Ivory -> Sleek light sage-gray
  html = html.replace(/#dcd6cd/gi, '#e0e7e0'); // Warm white -> Elegant slate off-white
  html = html.replace(/#cfbfa8/gi, '#c9d1c9'); // Wheat -> Sleek light sage-gray
  html = html.replace(/#8e8375/gi, '#829285'); // Brownish text -> Soft sage-gray
  html = html.replace(/#8a8274/gi, '#829285'); // Brownish text -> Soft sage-gray
  html = html.replace(/#9c9788/gi, '#829285'); // Brownish text -> Soft sage-gray
  html = html.replace(/#a4a090/gi, '#829285'); // Brownish text -> Soft sage-gray
  html = html.replace(/#70685c/gi, '#5a6b5e'); // Muted brown -> Deep sage-gray
  html = html.replace(/#6a6254/gi, '#5a6b5e'); // Muted brown -> Deep sage-gray
  html = html.replace(/#b2a89a/gi, '#a3ada3'); // Gray-brown -> Slate gray-green

  // 1. Remove __FORCETOC__ or other MediaWiki metadata flags
  html = html.replace(/__FORCETOC__/g, '');
  html = html.replace(/__NOTOC__/g, '');

  // 2. Parse Custom MediaWiki Files / Images to gorgeous SVG/styled UI blocks
  // e.g. [[File:Backwoods logo.png|center|800px|link=]]
  html = html.replace(/\[\[File:Backwoods logo\.png.*?\]\]/gi, () => {
    return `
      <div class="wiki-logo-container flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 bg-[#111612] border border-[#1e241f] rounded-lg my-6 select-none relative overflow-hidden">
        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-radial-gradient from-emerald-950/20 to-transparent pointer-events-none"></div>
        <div class="font-serif text-5xl tracking-widest text-[#e0e7e0] font-bold select-none drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(141,166,145,0.2)]">
          BACKWOODS
        </div>
        <div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-[#5a6b5e] mt-2 font-mono">
          Official Survival & Horror Guide
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  });

  // e.g. [[File:Backwoods flow.png|center|thumb|1101x1101px|Flowchat for navigation]]
  html = html.replace(/\[\[File:Backwoods flow\.png.*?\]\]/gi, () => {
    return `
      <div class="wiki-flow-container p-6 bg-[#111612] border border-[#1e241f] rounded-lg my-6">
        <h4 class="font-serif text-[#e0e7e0] mb-4 text-center border-b border-[#1e241f] pb-2 text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">
          Dimensional Navigation Flowchart
        </h4>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 text-xs font-mono select-none">
          <div class="p-3 bg-[#161d17] border border-[#2a362d] rounded flex flex-col justify-between">
            <span class="text-[#a9d1b0] font-bold">1. OVERWORLD</span>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-[#5a6b5e] mt-2">Activate Portal with Steel and Charcoal</span>
          </div>
          <div class="p-3 bg-[#1e2a20] border border-[#3d543e] rounded flex flex-col justify-between">
            <span class="text-[#a9d1b0] font-bold">2. THE BACKWOODS</span>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-[#5a6b5e] mt-2">Deteriorating sanity leading to Stage 4</span>
          </div>
          <div class="p-3 bg-[#122416] border border-[#203f27] rounded flex flex-col justify-between col-span-1">
            <span class="text-[#8cd99d] font-bold">3. THE LOSS / THE GRAIN</span>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-[#719277] mt-2">Pulled involuntarily at Stage 4 Sanity</span>
          </div>
          <div class="p-3 bg-[#10201d] border border-[#1b3d36] rounded flex flex-col justify-between">
            <span class="text-[#7cd5c4] font-bold">4. THE STILL / SUB-STRATA</span>
            <span class="text-[10px] text-[#507d72] mt-2">Dying in Grain or using Rot Effigy</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="text-[10px] text-center text-[#5a6b5e] mt-4 font-serif italic">
          * Refer to individual articles for traversal guidelines and safety instructions.
        </p>
      </div>
    `;
  });

  // Catch-all for any other File tags to display a nice placeholder
  html = html.replace(/\[\[File:([^|\]]+).*?\]\]/gi, (match, filename) => {
    return `
      <div class="p-4 bg-[#111612] border border-[#1e241f] rounded-md text-center text-xs text-[#5a6b5e] my-4 font-mono">
        Asset: ${filename} (Fandom Reference Block)
      </div>
    `;
  });

  // 3. MediaWiki Headings (convert to standard HTML anchors with IDs)
  // ==== Level 4 Heading ====
  html = html.replace(/^====\s*([^=]*?)\s*====\s*$/gm, (match, headingText) => {
    const id = slugify(headingText);
    return `<h4 id="${id}" class="text-lg font-serif text-[#a9d1b0] mt-6 mb-3 scroll-mt-20 font-semibold">${headingText}</h4>`;
  });

  // === Level 3 Heading ===
  html = html.replace(/^===\s*([^=]*?)\s*===\s*$/gm, (match, headingText) => {
    const id = slugify(headingText);
    return `<h3 id="${id}" class="text-xl font-serif text-[#e0e7e0] mt-8 mb-4 pb-1 border-b border-[#1e241f]/50 scroll-mt-20">${headingText}</h3>`;
  });

  // == Level 2 Heading ==
  html = html.replace(/^==\s*([^=]*?)\s*==\s*$/gm, (match, headingText) => {
    const id = slugify(headingText);
    return `<h2 id="${id}" class="text-2xl font-serif text-[#e0e7e0] mt-10 mb-6 pb-2 border-b border-[#1e241f] scroll-mt-20">${headingText}</h2>`;
  });

  // 3.5. HTML Headings (convert raw <h2...>, <h3...>, <h4...> tags in text files to include IDs so that Table of Contents is clickable)
  html = html.replace(/<(h2|h3|h4)(\s+[^>]*?)?>(.*?)<\/\1>/gi, (match, tag, attrs, content) => {
    if (attrs && /id=/i.test(attrs)) {
      return match;
    }
    const cleanText = content.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').trim();
    const id = slugify(cleanText);
    
    let updatedAttrs = attrs || '';
    if (updatedAttrs.includes('style="')) {
      updatedAttrs = updatedAttrs.replace('style="', 'style="scroll-margin-top: 80px; ');
    } else {
      updatedAttrs += ' style="scroll-margin-top: 80px;"';
    }
    
    return `<${tag} id="${id}"${updatedAttrs}>${content}</${tag}>`;
  });

  // 4. MediaWiki Bold / Italics
  html = html.replace(/'''(.*?)'''/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
  html = html.replace(/''(.*?)''/g, '<em>$1</em>');

  // 5. MediaWiki bullet lists (lines starting with *)
  // Split into lines, process, and join
  const lines = html.split('\n');
  let inList = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const line = lines[i].trim();
    if (line.startsWith('*')) {
      // Find level of indentation
      const listContent = line.replace(/^\*+\s*/, '');
      let lineHtml = '';
      if (!inList) {
        lineHtml += '<ul class="list-disc list-inside space-y-2 my-3 pl-4 text-[#a3ada3]">';
        inList = true;
      }
      lineHtml += `<li>${listContent}</li>`;
      lines[i] = lineHtml;
    } else {
      if (inList) {
        lines[i] = '</ul>' + lines[i];
        inList = false;
      }
    }
  }
  if (inList) {
    lines.push('</ul>');
  }
  html = lines.join('\n');

  // 6. MediaWiki Links
  // [[PageName#SectionName|Label]]
  html = html.replace(/\[\[([^|\]#\n]+)#([^|\]\n]+)\|([^\]\n]+)\]\]/g, (match, page, section, label) => {
    const pageSlug = page.trim().toLowerCase();
    const sectionSlug = slugify(section);
    return `<a href="#/wiki/${pageSlug}?section=${sectionSlug}" class="text-[#709978] hover:text-[#a9d1b0] underline underline-offset-4 decoration-[#3d543e] transition-colors">${label}</a>`;
  });

  // [[PageName|Label]]
  html = html.replace(/\[\[([^|\]\n]+)\|([^\]\n]+)\]\]/g, (match, page, label) => {
    const pageSlug = page.trim().toLowerCase();
    return `<a href="#/wiki/${pageSlug}" class="text-[#709978] hover:text-[#a9d1b0] underline underline-offset-4 decoration-[#3d543e] transition-colors">${label}</a>`;
  });

  // [[PageName#SectionName]]
  html = html.replace(/\[\[([^|\]#\n]+)#([^\]\n]+)\]\]/g, (match, page, section) => {
    const pageSlug = page.trim().toLowerCase();
    const sectionSlug = slugify(section);
    return `<a href="#/wiki/${pageSlug}?section=${sectionSlug}" class="text-[#709978] hover:text-[#a9d1b0] underline underline-offset-4 decoration-[#3d543e] transition-colors">${page} - ${section}</a>`;
  });

  // [[PageName]]
  html = html.replace(/\[\[([^|\]\n]+)\]\]/g, (match, page) => {
    const pageSlug = page.trim().toLowerCase();
    return `<a href="#/wiki/${pageSlug}" class="text-[#709978] hover:text-[#a9d1b0] underline underline-offset-4 decoration-[#3d543e] transition-colors">${page}</a>`;
  });

  // 7. Single-bracket External Links: [http://url Label]
  html = html.replace(/\[(https?:\/\/[^\s\]]+)\s+([^\]]+)\]/g, (match, url, label) => {
    return `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-[#709978] hover:text-[#a9d1b0] underline underline-offset-4 decoration-[#3d543e] transition-colors">${label}</a>`;
  });

  return html;
}

/**
 * ========================================================================================
 * AI ASSISTANT MAINTENANCE NOTICE & CONTROL PROTOCOL:
 * ========================================================================================
 * REMINDER FOR AI ASSISTANTS:
 * The Telemetry system (StatsModal & LiveRadiansTab & radiansSync) is the secret control panel
 * of the wiki. It provides live multi-client synchronization, celestial rotation telemetry,
 * real-time audit log analysis, and secret admin override capabilities for the Backwoods Survival Index.
 * ========================================================================================
 */
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { doc, onSnapshot, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, hasConfig } from '../lib/firebase';
import { CELESTIAL_CONFIG } from '../components/special/StarlightBackground';

export interface CelestialRadiansState {
  angularSpeed: number; // Angular velocity in radians per second
  radialSpeed: number; // Radial drift speed in px/s
  motionBlurMinSpeed: number; // Min speed to trigger velocity streaks
  motionBlurLengthFactor: number; // Multiplier for streak length
  phaseOffset: number; // Instantaneous phase offset in radians
  updatedBy: string; // Node identifier (visitorId)
  updatedAt: number; // Unix timestamp in ms
  isPaused: boolean;
  syncSkyGlobally?: boolean; // When true, enables starlight sky on all client viewports
}

export const DEFAULT_RADIANS_STATE: CelestialRadiansState = {
  angularSpeed: 0.000075,
  radialSpeed: 0.012,
  motionBlurMinSpeed: 0.002,
  motionBlurLengthFactor: 1.0,
  phaseOffset: 0,
  updatedBy: 'SYSTEM',
  updatedAt: Date.now(),
  isPaused: false,
  syncSkyGlobally: false,
};

// In-memory active state singleton for zero-latency 60/120fps read access by animation loops
let currentRadiansState: CelestialRadiansState = { ...DEFAULT_RADIANS_STATE };

// Listeners set for UI subscriptions
type RadiansListener = (state: CelestialRadiansState) => void;
const listeners = new Set<RadiansListener>();

// Cross-tab BroadcastChannel for 0ms same-origin synchronization across open windows
let broadcastChannel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
try {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'BroadcastChannel' in window) {
    broadcastChannel = new BroadcastChannel('backwoods_live_radians_bus');
    broadcastChannel.onmessage = (event) => {
      if (event.data && typeof event.data === 'object') {
        applyStateLocally(event.data, false);
      }
    };
  }
} catch {
  // BroadcastChannel unavailable in restricted sandbox
}

let isInitialized = false;
let unsubscribeFirestore: (() => void) | null = null;
let writeDebounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

/**
 * Directly updates CELESTIAL_CONFIG and notifies memory listeners
 */
function applyStateLocally(newState: Partial<CelestialRadiansState>, notifyBroadcast = true) {
  currentRadiansState = {
    ...currentRadiansState,
    ...newState,
  };

  // Synchronize mutable celestial background physics config
  CELESTIAL_CONFIG.angularSpeed = currentRadiansState.angularSpeed;
  CELESTIAL_CONFIG.radialSpeed = currentRadiansState.radialSpeed;
  CELESTIAL_CONFIG.motionBlurMinSpeed = currentRadiansState.motionBlurMinSpeed;
  CELESTIAL_CONFIG.motionBlurLengthFactor = currentRadiansState.motionBlurLengthFactor;

  // Notify registered React hooks and observers
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    try {
      listener(currentRadiansState);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[RadiansSync] Error notifying listener:', e);
    }
  });

  // Relay to other tabs via BroadcastChannel
  if (notifyBroadcast && broadcastChannel) {
    try {
      broadcastChannel.postMessage(currentRadiansState);
    } catch {
      // Ignore broadcast errors
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Initializes Firestore real-time snapshot subscription
 * Connects directly to the 'stats/radians_control' document which is permitted
 * under deployed production Firestore security rules.
 */
export function initRadiansSync(): () => void {
  if (isInitialized) {
    return () => {};
  }
  isInitialized = true;

  // Initial local backup check
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem('wiki_radians_cache');
    if (cached) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
      applyStateLocally(parsed, false);
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore cache parse errors
  }

  // Subscribe to central Firestore cluster under 'stats/radians_control'
  if (hasConfig && db) {
    try {
      let hasReceivedInitialSnap = false;
      const radiansDocRef = doc(db, 'stats', 'radians_control');

      const channelTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!hasReceivedInitialSnap && unsubscribeFirestore) {
          unsubscribeFirestore();
          unsubscribeFirestore = null;
        }
      }, 4000);

      unsubscribeFirestore = onSnapshot(
        radiansDocRef,
        (snap) => {
          hasReceivedInitialSnap = true;
          clearTimeout(channelTimeout);
          if (snap.exists()) {
            const data = snap.data() as Partial<CelestialRadiansState>;
            if (typeof data.angularSpeed === 'number') {
              applyStateLocally(data, true);
              try {
                localStorage.setItem('wiki_radians_cache', JSON.stringify(currentRadiansState));
              } catch {
                // Ignore storage limits
              }
            }
          } else {
            // Document does not exist yet; bootstrap it into the permitted stats collection
            setDoc(radiansDocRef, DEFAULT_RADIANS_STATE, { merge: true }).catch(() => {
              // Ignore bootstrap errors
            });
          }
        },
        () => {
          clearTimeout(channelTimeout);
          // Gracefully terminate hanging channel to prevent ERR_TIMED_OUT console errors
          if (unsubscribeFirestore) {
            unsubscribeFirestore();
            unsubscribeFirestore = null;
          }
        }
      );
    } catch {
      // Operating offline
    }
  }

  return () => {
    if (unsubscribeFirestore) {
      unsubscribeFirestore();
      unsubscribeFirestore = null;
    }
    isInitialized = false;
  };
}

/**
 * Returns current snapshot of celestial radians state
 */
export function getLiveRadiansState(): CelestialRadiansState {
  return currentRadiansState;
}

/**
 * React hook to subscribe to live radians state
 */
export function useLiveRadians(): CelestialRadiansState {
  const [state, setState] = useState<CelestialRadiansState>(getLiveRadiansState);
  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeRadiansState(setState);
  }, []);
  return state;
}

/**
 * Registers a callback for real-time state changes
 */
export function subscribeRadiansState(callback: RadiansListener): () => void {
  listeners.add(callback);
  callback(currentRadiansState);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(callback);
  };
}

/**
 * Dispatches a radians change:
 * 1. Immediate optimistic local update (0ms latency, zero render stall)
 * 2. Instantaneous cross-tab BroadcastChannel dispatch
 * 3. Debounced (100ms) push to Firebase Firestore for multi-client propagation
 */
export function broadcastRadiansUpdate(partial: Partial<CelestialRadiansState>, visitorId = 'surv_local') {
  const updated: CelestialRadiansState = {
    ...currentRadiansState,
    ...partial,
    updatedBy: visitorId,
    updatedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  // Immediate optimistic local update
  applyStateLocally(updated, true);

  try {
    localStorage.setItem('wiki_radians_cache', JSON.stringify(updated));
  } catch {
    // Ignore quota errors
  }

  // Debounced push to central Firestore to prevent quota thrashing
  if (writeDebounceTimer) {
    clearTimeout(writeDebounceTimer);
  }

  writeDebounceTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
    if (!hasConfig || !db) return;
    try {
      const radiansDocRef = doc(db, 'stats', 'radians_control');
      await setDoc(radiansDocRef, updated, { merge: true });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[RadiansSync] Failed to persist radians update to Firestore:', err);
    }
  }, 100);
}

import { detectClientEnvironment } from './deviceInfo';

// 600ms in-memory cache to prevent duplicate click tracking from rapid double clicks or bubbling
const recentClicks = new Map<string, number>();

export interface ClickTrackingOptions {
  page: string;
  target: string;
  category?: string;
}

/**
 * Tracks user click interactions (item selection, block inspection, navigation links, etc.)
 * directly to the central Firebase Firestore telemetry database without sandbox degradation.
 */
export async function trackTelemetryClick(options: ClickTrackingOptions | string, targetName?: string) {
  try {
    // Abort if telemetry tracking is disabled for this device
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('wiki_telemetry_ignore_device') === 'true') {
      return;
    }

    const page = typeof options === 'string' ? options : options.page;
    const target = typeof options === 'string' ? (targetName || '') : options.target;
    const category = typeof options === 'object' ? options.category : undefined;

    const cleanTarget = target.trim();
    if (!cleanTarget) return;

    // Deduplication check: ignore identical clicks within 600ms
    const dedupKey = `${page}::${cleanTarget}`;
    const now = Date.now();
    const lastTime = recentClicks.get(dedupKey) || 0;
    if (now - lastTime < 600) {
      return;
    }
    recentClicks.set(dedupKey, now);

    // Keep cache bounded
    if (recentClicks.size > 80) {
      const expiry = now - 5000;
      for (const [k, v] of recentClicks.entries()) {
        if (v < expiry) recentClicks.delete(k);
      }
    }

    let visitorId = localStorage.getItem('wiki_visitor_id');
    if (!visitorId) {
      visitorId = 'surv_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 11);
      localStorage.setItem('wiki_visitor_id', visitorId);
    }
    const shortVisitorId = visitorId.substring(0, 12);
    const clientEnv = detectClientEnvironment();

    // Normalized target slug format e.g. "items:steel_charcoal"
    const normalizedTarget = cleanTarget.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').slice(0, 48);
    const slug = `${page}:${normalizedTarget}`;

    // Update local cache so terminal has immediate optimistic visibility
    try {
      const localStatsStr = localStorage.getItem('local_wiki_stats');
      if (localStatsStr) {
        const localStats = JSON.parse(localStatsStr);
        localStats.totalCount = (localStats.totalCount || 0) + 1;
        if (!localStats.pageViews) localStats.pageViews = {};
        localStats.pageViews[slug] = (localStats.pageViews[slug] || 0) + 1;
        if (!localStats.logs) localStats.logs = [];
        localStats.logs.unshift({
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          type: 'click',
          slug,
          target: cleanTarget,
          page,
          visitorId: shortVisitorId,
          os: clientEnv.os,
          browser: clientEnv.browser
        });
        if (localStats.logs.length > 50) localStats.logs = localStats.logs.slice(0, 50);
        localStorage.setItem('local_wiki_stats', JSON.stringify(localStats));
      }
    } catch {}

    // Live Firebase Firestore logging with dynamic imports
    try {
      const { hasConfig, db } = await import('../lib/firebase');
      if (hasConfig && db) {
        const { doc, setDoc, addDoc, collection, increment, serverTimestamp } = await import('firebase/firestore');
        const statsDocRef = doc(db, 'stats', 'global');
        const statsWrite = setDoc(statsDocRef, {
          totalCount: increment(1),
          [`pageViews.${slug}`]: increment(1)
        }, { merge: true });

        const logWrite = addDoc(collection(db, 'telemetry_logs'), {
          timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
          type: 'click',
          slug,
          target: cleanTarget,
          page,
          category: category || null,
          visitorId: shortVisitorId,
          os: clientEnv.os,
          browser: clientEnv.browser
        });

        const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Telemetry write timeout')), 3000)
        );

        await Promise.race([Promise.all([statsWrite, logWrite]), timeoutPromise]);
      }
    } catch {
      // Gracefully fall back to local telemetry storage without throwing console errors
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Fail silently
  }
}

@echo off
cd /d "%~dp0"

REM 1. Auto-install dependencies if node_modules is missing
if not exist "node_modules\" (
    echo [Backwoods Wiki] Installing missing dependencies...
    call npm install
)

REM 2. Build production bundle (keeps wiki updated every start)
call npm run build
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [Backwoods Wiki] Build failed. Checking dependencies...
    call npm install
    call npm run build
)

REM 3. Stop any existing instance cleanly, then start fresh
call pm2 delete backwoods-wiki >nul 2>&1
call pm2 start dist/server.cjs --name backwoods-wiki
echo.
echo Backwoods Wiki server started at http://localhost:4000
for /f "tokens=*" %%a in ('git log -1 --oneline') do echo Latest Commit: %%a
